Ka sulat ni Pablu te

The letter by Paul to

Matig-Ruma

The (ones) from_Ruma

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka Sulat ni Pablu te Matig-Ruma impeendiye din te me Hudiyu wey te kene ne me Hudiyu ne egpalintutuu wey egsalig ki Hisu Kristu. Insulatan din sikandan eyew egpakaandam te pegbebentaan din ne pegpanumbaley diye te kandan. Migplanu si Apustulis Pablu ne egtrabahu duma te me Kristuwanen diye te kene de egkaluhey, ne egkataman eggendiyad sikandin te Ispanya pinaahi te bulig dan. Migsulat sikandin eyew te pegpangguhud meyitenged te pegsabut din te pegpalintutuu te Kristuwanen wey te aldew-aldew ne peg-ugpe isip me Kristuwanen. Ka seini ne baseen, nasulatan te kumplitu ne pegpasabut ni Pablu meyitenged te guhuren din.

The Letter of Pablu to The (ones) from_Ruma he sent to the Hudiyus and non Hudiyus who believe and trust Hisu Kristu. He wrote to them so_that (they) would_be_able_to_prepare for his travel_plans to visit them. Apostle Pablu planned to work with the Christians there for a short time, and afterwards he would_go to Ispanya by_means of their help. He wrote in_order to story about his understanding of the Christian faith and of living each_day as a Christian. This document (LIT reading), (it) was_written with the complete revelation (LIT causing_to_understand) of Pablu concerning his message.

Impangemusta rin ka migmalintutuu diye te Ruma, wey impangguhuran din te in-ampuan din sikandan. Pegkapenga rue, ingguhud e ni Pablu ka uluwan te sulat din, “Su pinaahi te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, impanengneng te Manama ke immenu rin te eg-isip ne matareng ka me etew.” (1:17a). Ka langun ne etew, Hudiyu ma wey se kene, keilangan ne egkeyimu ne matareng diye te tangkaan te Manama pinaahi te pegpalintutuu ki Hisu Kristu.

He greeted the believers in Ruma, and he told (them) that he prayed for them. After that, Pablu stated the topic of his letter, “For by_means of the Good Report, God (MS Manama) made_known how he considers people righteous.” (1:17a). All people, Hudiyu and non, (they) need to become righteous in the presence of God by_means of faith in Hisu Kristu.

Ka seup ne impangguhud ni Pablu iyan ka iyam ne umul pinaahi te pegsabeka ki Kristu ne diye egpangkus te iyam ne rilasyun diye te Manama. Duen e keupianan te migmalintutuu duma te Manama wey inluwas sikandan pinaahi te geem te Panisingan te Manama puun te geem te sale wey te kamatayen. Te kapitulu 5-8, migpangguhud si Pablu meyitenged te tuyu te Balaud te Manama wey te geem te Panisingan te Manama due te migmalintutuu.

The next thing_told by Pablu is that new life by_means of oneness with Kristu results in a new relationship with God. Believers have peace with God and they are_saved by_means of the power of the Spirit of God from the power of sin and death. In chapters 5-8, Pablu told about the purpose of the Law of God and the power of the Spirit of God in believer(s).

Migpakannekal si Pablu ne egkatabak din ka inse ke egmenuwen ne egpakatupu ka me Hudiyu wey ka kene ne me Hudiyu te planu te Manama para te langun ne etew. Impasabut ni Pablu ne baad e te planu te Manama ne ka peggubabe te me Hudiyu te kene de egkaluhey diye egpangkus te igpakawali ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen diye te kene ne me Hudiyu. Piru meyitenged te peg-alam te Manama te me Hudiyu, indakelan din ded sikandan te geyinawa tenged te saad din te kaap-apuan dan. Puun kayi, ka langun ne etew egpakarawat te geyinawa wey hid-u te Manama pinaahi ki Kristu Hisus.

Pablu strove to answer the question of how Hudiyus and non Hudiyus fit into the plan of God for all people. Paul made known that part of the plan of God was for the disbelief of the Hudiyus for not a long time to result in the preaching of the Good Report to the non Hudiyus. But concerning God's choosing of the Hudiyu, he greatly loved them because of his promise to their ancestors. From this, all people will_be_able_to_receive the love and mercy of God by_means of Kristu Hisus.

Te katammanan, migpanengneng si Pablu ke egmenuwen te peg-ugpe isip Kristuwanen, labew en iya te paahi te pegparawdawatey wey pegpaheyheyinaweey te tagse sabeka. Inlagkes din degma ka me uluwan iling te pegpamakey te Manama, ka katungdanan ne keilangan ne eggimuwen te me Kristuwanen diye te gubirnu wey te tagse sabeka, wey ka me inse meyitenged te kunsinsya. In-epus ni Pablu ka sulat din pinaahi te pegpangemusta rin wey te me duma rin, wey te pegsaye din te Manama.

In conclusion, Pablu made_known how to live as a Christian, foremost indeed the way of mutual_acceptance and mutual_love for each one. He also included topics like service to God, the responsibilities that Christians need to do for the government and to each one, and questions concerning conscience. Pablu finished his letter by_means of his and his companions' sending_regards, and with praise to God.

11 Sikeddiey si Pablu ka migpeuyan kayi. Uripen a ni Hisu Kristu wey in-alam a ne egkeyimu ne apustulis eyew egwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen 2 ne insaad dengan te Manama pinaahi te me prupita diye te Matulus ne Kasulatan. 3 Ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen, meyitenged sika te Anak din ne si Hisu Kristu. Ne sumale te kandin ne pegkeetew, kabuhalan sikandin ni Dabid. 4 Ne meyitenged te pegkamatulus din isip Manama,[fn] impakita te Amey ne Anak din ka Magbebaye ta te peg-uyag kandin pinaahi te geem din. 5 Pinaahi ki Kristu wey eyew egkareyrey sikandin, neyimu key ne apustulis tenged te keupiya te Manama eyew egpanulu te langun ne etew ne egpalintutuu wey egtuman kandin. 6 Sikaniyu degma se matig-Ruma, inlagkes kew alama te Manama eyew egkasabeka due ki Hisu Kristu.

11 I Pablu have sent this. I (am) a slave of Hisu Kristu and I was_chosen to become an apostle in_order to preach the Good Report 2 that was promised formerly by God by_means of the prophets in the Holy Writings. 3 The Good Report, it concerns his Child Hisu Kristu. According to his humanity (LIT personhood), he was a descendant of Dabid. 4 And concerning his divine nature (LIT holiness as God),[fn] the Father revealed that our(incl) Lord is his Offspring by raising_ him _to_life by_means of his power. 5 By_means of Kristu and so_that he will_be_praised, we(excl) became apostles as a result of the goodness of God in_order to teach all people to believe and obey him. 6 You(pl) from_Ruma (ones) also, you(pl) are included in God's choosing in_order to become_one in Hisu Kristu.

7 Migsusulat a kaniyu langun due te Ruma ne miggeyinawaan wey in-alam te Manama ne egkeyimu ne me keet-etawan din.

7 I am_writing to all of you(pl) there in Ruma who are loved and were_chosen by God to become his people.

Ka keyid-u wey keupianan ne egpuun te Manama ne Amey wey te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu, egkaangken niyu.

(May) the mercy and peace from God the Father and our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu, be received by you(pl).

Ka pegbebentaan ni Pablu ne egpanumbaley diye te Ruma

The plan of Pablu to visit in Ruma

8 Hun-a te langun, egpasalamat a te Manama ta pinaahi ki Hisu Kristu tenged kaniyu langun su nahuhud diye te langun ne inged ka pegpalintutuu niyu. 9 Ka Manama ka talagpamalehet ku ne layun ku sikaniyu iglagkes te peg-ampu ku. Sikandin ka Manama ne impamakey ku pinaahi te pegpakannekal ku te pegwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged te Anak din. 10 Layun a eg-ampu diye te kandin ne igtuhut din perem ne egpakapanumbaley ad due te kaniyu. Su naluhey e 11 ne amana ad iya egkeupian ne egpakigkita kaniyu eyew egpakapanulu a kaniyu te katuenan puun te Panisingan te Manama eyew egkeehet ka pegpalintutuu niyu. 12 Iyan ku igpasabut ne egmabagbaggetey ki eyew egkeehet ka pegpalintutuu ta langun.

8 First of all, I thank our(incl) God by_means of Hisu Kristu because of you(pl) all because your(pl) faith is spoken_of in every place. 9 God is my witness that I always include you(pl) in my praying. He (is) the God whom I serve by_means of my striving in preaching the Good Report about his Child. 10 I always pray to him that he will_ [hopefully] _permit that I will_be_able_to_visit there with you(pl). For a long_time 11 I have greatly desired to see you(pl) in_order for me to teach you(pl) knowledge from the Spirit of God in_order to draw_tight your(pl) faith. 12 What I mean is that we(incl) will_encourage_one_another so_that the faith of us(incl) all will_be_drawn_tight.

13 [xr]Me suled, egkeupian a ne egkanengnengan niyu ne kamasalig ad migbebentaan ne egpanumbaley due te kaniyu, piru due egpakabalabag keddiey taman kuntee. Egkeupian a ne eggendue su eyew duen e man-e perem me duma niyu due ne egkeuyan ku ne egpalintutuu e ki Hisus, iling te inggimu ku te kene ne me Hudiyu diye te duma ne me inged. 14 Su ka katungdanan ne keilangan ne eggimuwen ku iyan ka egpangguhud te Meupiya ne Panugtulen diye te langun ne etew ne nekeiskuyla wey ware nekeiskuyla, wey diye te matagseb wey kene ne matagseb. 15 Sikan naa ka egkabagget-bagget ad iya degma ne egwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen kaniyu due te Ruma.

13 [xr]Brother/friends, I want you(pl) to understand that many_times I have planned to visit there with you(pl), but something has hindered me until now. I want to go_there so_that there will_ also _be some I can persuade among you(pl) to believe/obey Hisus, like what_ I _did with the non Hudiyus in other places. 14 For the responsibility that I need to do is to story the Good Report to all people who went_to_school and (those who) did not go_to_school, and to the wise (ones) and the non wise (ones). 15 And so I am very excited to also preach the Good Report to you(pl) there at Ruma.

16 [xr]Su kene ku igkeyilew ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen, su sika ka geem te Manama te pegluwas te langun ne egpalintutuu, an-anayan ka me Hudiyu wey peendiye te kene ne me Hudiyu. 17 [xr]Su pinaahi te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, impanengneng te Manama ke immenu rin te eg-isip ne matareng ka me etew. In-isip din sikandan ne matareng pinaahi re te pegpalintutuu, su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan, “Egkeuyag ka etew ne namatareng pinaahi te pegpalintutuu rin.”

16 [xr]For I am_ not _ashamed of the Good Report, for it is the power of God for saving all who believe, first the Hudiyus and extending to the non Hudiyus. 17 [xr]For by_means of the Good Report, God made_known how he considers people righteous. He considers them righteous by_means only of faith, for according to what_is_written in the Writings, “A righteous person will_live by_means of his faith.”

Ka langet te Manama te me etew ne egsupak kandin

The anger of God at people who disobey him

18 Impanengneng te Manama ne diye te langit ne egkalangetan sikandin te me etew ne egsupak kandin wey maddeet se hinimuwan, su egkabalabahan ka kamalehetan te mareet ne hinimuwan dan. 19 Su ka kamalehetan meyitenged te Manama, nasabut dan e su sikandin mismu ka migpasabut kandan. 20 Minsan kene egkiteen ka Manama, impapitew rin kanta ka karesen din ne ware egtamanan wey ka pegka-Manama rin pinaahi te immangimu rin. Amana egkasabut seini puun dengan te peggimu te kalibutan. Sikan naa, kene iya sikandan egpakapanalakaye ne ware nakasabut. 21 [xr]Su minsan neilaan dan e ka Manama, piru ware dan sikandin dayana wey pasalamati isip Manama. Ke kene, ware karuan te egsumsumanen dan wey warad meupiya ne tahu te ulu ran, sikan naa ka kenad sikandan egsabut te kamalehetan. 22 Kahiyen dan ne me matagseb sikandan, kunaleg te egkengeungel bes. 23 [xr]Ne ware dan simbaa ka Manama ne ware egpatayan, ke kene, iyan dan insimba ka diyus-diyus ne impeiling te etew ne due kamatayen, wey te manuk-manuk, me mananap wey te me uled.

18 God who is in heaven made_known that he is angry with people who disobey him and whose deeds are wicked, because the truth is hindered by their wicked deeds. 19 For the truth about God, they already know because he himself made_ it _known to them. 20 Even though God is not seen, he reveals to_us(incl) his power without ending and his Godness by means of what_ he _has_made. This has been very_well understood from long_ago at the creation of the world. And so, they are_ not _able_to_make_excuses that (they) didn't understand. 21 [xr]For although they knew God, however they did not praise or thank him as God. But rather, their thinking was useless and there_was no_more good inside their head(s), and so they no_longer understood the truth. 22 They said that they (are) wise, but_on_the_contrary (they are) fools [emphasis]. 23 [xr]And they did not worship the God who does not die, but rather, what they worshiped were idols in the likeness of people who die (LIT have death), and birds and wild_animals, and snakes.

24 Purisu imparuyun-duyunan e sikandan te Manama ne eggimu te mallindit ne igkeupii te suman-suman[fn] dan, sikan naa ka migparulun-dulunan dan e ka langun ne malindit ne himu ne egpekeyilew te me lawa ran. 25 Ne ware sikandan migpalintutuu te kamalehetan meyitenged te Manama su iyan dan impalintutuuwan ka ubat. Ne iyan dan insimba wey impamakey ka inggimu re te Manama wey imbalahad dan ka Talaggimu ne iyan perem eleg ne egsayeen te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya!

24 Therefore they were indulged by God to do the dirty_things that their thoughts[fn] desired, and so they all gave_into the dirty deeds that shame their bodies. 25 They did not believe the truth concerning God for what they believed_in is a lie. What they worshiped and served was what was just created by God and they neglected the Creator who is the right (one) who ought to be_praised without end. True indeed!

26 Puun due, imparuyun-duyunan e sikandan te Manama ne egparulun-dulun te mekeyilew-hilew ne igkeibeg te me lawa ran. Ne minsan ka me malitan, kenad ne lukes pad ka egguliren dan su egmeel-eliney e. 27 Ne iling ded degma ka me lukes, me baliyuten e sikandan wey kenad ne malitan ka egguliren dan su egmeel-eliney e degma. Sikandan se migparulun-dulun kayi te mekeyilew-hilew ne hinimuwan, egdusaan sikandan sumale te sale dan.

26 From that, they were indulged by God to give_into shameful_things that their bodies craved. Even the females, it was no_longer males that they lay_down (euph for sex) with for (they) had same_sex_contact. 27 And also the same (are) the males, they are lustful/immoral and it is no_longer women that they lay_down (euph for sex) with for (they) also have same_sex_contact. Those who gave_into in these shameful deeds, they will_be_severely_punished according to their sin.

28 Ne puun su ware karuan kandan ka peg-ila te Manama, imparuyun-duyunan din e sikandan te mallindit ne suman-suman dan wey te hinimuwan ne kene perem ne eleg ne eggimuwen. 29 Neelin naan de iya ne mareet ka egkasuman-suman dan ne eggimuwen. Maddeet sikandan, me halamlamen, me talagdereet, me iimmeen, me talaggimatey, me usig, me limbungen, malindit se egsumsumanen wey salupeten. 30 Me id-iranen sikandan wey egdumut te Manama. Malangit ne egpanlelalag, egmapitew-pitew re wey me hambuhen, layun egsuman-suman te mareet ne eggimuwen wey talagsupak te amey wey iney ran. 31 Egkengeungel sikandan, kene egkasalihan, ware geyinawa ran diye te duma wey kene ne hiid-uwen. 32 Minsan nanengnengan dan e ka Balaud te Manama ne likes te kamatayen ka eggimu te iling dutu, piru imparulun-dulunan dan ded seeye ne eggimuwen wey indayan dan pad ka duma ne eggimu te iling dutu.

28 And since the recognizing of God was of no use to them, he indulged them to their dirty thinking and to deeds that should not be fitting to do. 29 Indeed all that they think to do is wicked. They are wicked, greedy, evil_doers, envious, murderers, enemies, deceivers, evil thinkers and gossipers. 30 They are backstabbers and hate God. Disrespectful speakers, just hypocrites and proud (ones), always thinking of wicked things_to_do and ones_disobedient to their father and mother. 31 They are foolish, are not trustworthy, have_no love for their companions and are not merciful. 32 Although they knew the law of God that ones_doing like that (are) worthy of death, however they gave_into doing_ those _things and they praised others who did like that.

Ka matareng ne peggukum te Manama

The righteous judgment of God

21 [xr]Na, kene ka suman-suman ne egpakapanalakaye ka te Manama te peggukum nu te duma nu ne mareet se hinimuwan iling keykew. Su emun ke miggukuman nu sikandin, sikeykew red iya ka miggukum te pegkeetew nu. 2 Su nakanengneng ki ne eleg ka Manama te peggukum din te me etew ne mareet se hinimuwan. 3 Purisu kene ka suman-suman ne egpakaalihu ka te legpad te Manama ke nekeg-iling kew red te miggukuman nu ne mareet se hinimuwan. 4 Ka Manama amana iya ne meupiya kanta, nenaneyi egkeupul, wey kene egkapelaan. Ne kema ke immareet nu re te egsuman-suman sika? Ware ke bes nakataha te neyid-u keykew ka Manama eyew eg-inniyug ka te me sale nu? 5 Piru tenged su makehal ka ulu nu wey kene ka eg-inniyug te sale, nasi egmabehat ka iglegpad te Manama keykew te aldew te langet din. Te sikan aldew, egkakite e ka matareng ne peggukum din. 6 [xr]Su egsulian te Manama ka tagse sabeka sumale te hinimuwan din. 7 Egbehayan din te umul ne ware egtamanan seeye se migpabulus miggimu te meupiya eyew egkarayan te Manama wey egbantuhen. 8 Piru seeye se egmanuhes-tuhes wey ware migpalintutuu te kamalehetan wey nasi miggimu te mareet, egpakaneem-neem te egmangebel-ebel ne langet te Manama. 9 Egkabaybayaran wey egkalasayan ka langun ne etew ne miggimu te mareet: an-anayan ka me Hudiyu wey peendiye te kene ne me Hudiyu. 10 Piru egkarayan wey egbantuhen wey egbehayan te keupianan te Manama ka langun ne miggimu te meupiya: an-anayan ka me Hudiyu wey peendiye te kene ne me Hudiyu 11 [xr]su nekeg-iling de iya ka peggukum te Manama te langun.

21 [xr]Now then, don't think that you(sg) will_be_able_to_make_excuses to God for your(sg) judging your(sg) companion of evil deeds like you(sg) (do). For if you(sg) judge him, you(sg) have indeed judged your(sg) self/personhood. 2 For we(incl) know that God's judging of people whose deeds are evil is right/correct. 3 Therefore don't(sg) think that you(sg) will_be_able_to_bypass the judgment of God if you(pl) and the one_ you(sg) _judged whose deeds are evil are alike. 4 God is indeed very good to us(incl), very_slow to get frustrated, and not impatient. Perhaps your(sg) thinking about that is evil? Don't you(sg) understand that God is merciful to you(sg) so_that you(sg) will_turn from your(sg) sins? 5 But since your(sg) head is hard (IDIOM stubborn) and you(sg) did not turn from sin, instead the punishment of God to you(sg) will_be_heavier on the day of his anger. On that day, his righteous judgment will_be_revealed. 6 [xr]For God will_repay each one according to his deeds. 7 He will_give life without end to those who continue to do good in_order to be_praised and honored by God. 8 But those who are self_pleasing and don't obey/believe the truth but instead do evil, (they) will_experience (LIT taste) the smokey anger of God. 9 All people who do evil will_suffer and be troubled: first the Hudiyus and extending to the non Hudiyus. 10 But all who do good will_be_praised and honored and given the peace of God: first the Hudiyus and extending to the non Hudiyus 11 [xr]for the judging of God is indeed just the same for all.

12 Su egdusaan te Manama ka kene ne me Hudiyu emun ke egpakasale sikandan minsan ware sikandan nabehayi te Balaud te Manama. Ne ka me Hudiyu mule, egdusaan pinaahi te Balaud te Manama ke egpakasale sikandan. 13 Su kene ne iyan in-isip ne matareng diye te tangkaan te Manama ka migpammineg te Balaud, ke kene, ka migtuman te Balaud. 14 Su minsan ware nabehayi te Balaud te Manama ka kene ne me Hudiyu, piru hendue te egkatuman dan ded ka Balaud ke egpanuluen sikandan te suman-suman dan te eleg ne eggimuwen. 15 Impakita ran pinaahi te meupiya ne himu ran ne napamulaan e ka me pusung dan te me suhu diye te Balaud, su egpakasuman-suman e sikandan ke meupiya naa ka inggimu ran wey ke mareet. 16 Egkeyitabu seini te aldew ne egpewukuman e te Manama ki Kristu Hisus ka neeles ne hinimuwan wey suman-suman te me etew, sumale te Meupiya ne Panugtulen ne inwali ku.

12 For the non Hudiyu will_be_punished_severely when they sin even_though they were not given the Law of God. And the Hudiyu on_the_contrary, (they) will_be_punished_severely by_means of the Law of God if they sin. 13 For the ones considered righteous in the presence of God (are) not the ones_listening to the Law, but rather, the ones_obeying the Law. 14 For although the non Hudiyu were not given the Law of God, yet (it is) like they fulfill the Law when they are taught the correct thing_to_do by their thoughts. 15 They showed by_means of their good deeds that the commands of the Law are planted in their hearts, for they understand whether what they do is good or evil. 16 This will_happen on the day that God causes_ Hisus _to_judge the hidden deeds and thoughts of people, according to the Good Report that I preached.

Ka me Hudiyu migsupak te Balaud

The Hudiyus disobey the Law

17 Sikaniyu se iling ku te Hudiyu, migsalig-salig kew te Balaud wey migpegpeggasal ne marani te Manama. 18 Ne nakanengneng kew degma ke nekey ka igkeupii te Manama wey napanulu te Balaud ke nekey ka meupiya. 19 Nasabeka ka suman-suman niyu ne talagkitkit kun te me butud, wey layag te seeye se diye pad te marusilem, 20 wey talagpanulu te me ungel, wey te me etew ne egpekeiling te me bate. Su nanengnengan niyu ne ka katuenan wey kamalehetan due te Balaud te Manama. 21 Na, kene niyu naa egpanuluen ka pegkeetew niyu ke talagpanulu kew te duma? Migwali kew ne kene egpanakew, egkaayun naa ne egpanakew kew? 22 Migkahi kew ne ingkene ka pegpanlibug, egpanlibug kew naa? Ingkeepes niyu ka me diyus-diyus, egpanakawan niyu naa ka me timplu ne impanahuan kayi? 23 Na sikaniyu se migpegpeggasal te Balaud te Manama, egpeyilawan niyu naa ka Manama pinaahi te pegsupak niyu te Balaud? 24 [xr]Su nasulat te Kasulatan, “Tenged kaniyu te me Hudiyu, imbaley-baley te kene ne me Hudiyu ka ngaran te Manama.”

17 You(pl) who are Hudiyu like me, you(pl) confidently_trust in the Law and boast that (you) are close to God. 18 You(pl) also know what God desires and (you) are taught what is good by the Law. 19 Your(pl) thoughts are unified that (you) are [hearsay] guides for blind (ones), and a light for those who are yet in darkness, 20 and teachers to the foolish, and to people who are_like children. For you(pl) know that knowledge and truth are in the Law of God. 21 Now_then, don't you(pl) teach your(pl) selves when you(pl) are teachers of others? You(pl) preach to not steal, is it possible that you(pl) steal? 22 You(pl) say that adultery is forbidden, do you(pl) commit_adultery? You(pl) disapprove of idols, do you(pl) steal from temples where they are stored? 23 Now_then you(pl) who boast in the Law of God, do you(pl) shame God by_means of your(pl) disobeying the Law? 24 [xr]For it is written in the Writings, “Because of you(pl) Hudiyu, the non Hudiyu blaspheme the name of God.”

25 Duen de karuan te pegpatuli niyu, ke egtumanen niyu ka Balaud. Piru ke egsupaken niyu ka Balaud, henduen kew red te kene ne me Hudiyu ne ware natulii. 26 Purisu ke egtumanen te kene ne me Hudiyu ka Balaud, minsan ware sikandan natulii piru eg-ileen te Manama ne natulian. 27 Sikandan se ware natulii piru egtuman te Balaud, iyan egpakapeyilew kaniyu diye te Manama su natulian kew wey due Balaud piru nasi migsupak kayi. 28 Su ka malehet ne Hudiyu, kene ne diye de te ulaula, wey ka malehet ne pegpatuli, kene ne diye de te lawa. 29 [xr]Ka malehet ne Hudiyu wey natulian, kene ne puun su natulian sikandin sumale te Balaud, ke kene, puun su imbalbalawan e te Panisingan te Manama ka pusung din. Minsan kene sikandin egdayanen te me etew piru ka Manama egdayan kandin.

25 There_is a usefulness for your(pl) circumcision, if you(pl) fulfill the Law. But if you(pl) disobey the Law, you(pl) are_like the non Hudiyu who are_ not _circumcised. 26 Therefore if the non Hudiyu fulfill the Law, even_though they are_ not _circumcised yet (they) are recognized by God as circumcised. 27 They who are_ not _circumcised but fulfill the Law, those (ones) will_be_able_to_shame you(pl) to God for you(pl) are_circumcised and have the Law but nevertheless disobey it. 28 For the true Hudiyu, (he) is not only (one) in appearance, and true circumcision, (it is) not just in the body. 29 [xr]The true Hudiyu and circumcised (one), it is not because he is circumcised according to the Law, but rather, because his heart has been_changed by the Spirit of God. Although he is not praised by people yet God praises him.

31 Na, nekey naa ka nakameupiya te me Hudiyu du te kene ne Hudiyu? Duen naa karuan te pegpatuli? 2 Amana ne masalig ka nakameupiya isip Hudiyu! Hun-a te langun, ka me Hudiyu ka insalihan te lalag te Manama. 3 Piru due me Hudiyu ne kene ne matinumanen. Puun due, kene naan e degma egmatinumanen ka Manama wey egbalaharen din naan e ka saad din? 4 [xr]Kene! Su kene ne ubaten ka Manama minsan pad ubaten ka langun ne etew. Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan,

31 Now_then, what is able_to_make_(it)_better as a Hudiyu than a non Hudiyu? Is there a usefulness for circumcision? 2 Very many_things make_(it)_better as a Hudiyu! First of all, the Hudiyu were entrusted with the word of God. 3 But there are Hudiyu who were not faithful. From that, will God also no_longer be faithful and will he neglect his promise? 4 [xr]No! For God is not a liar even_though all people (are) liars. For according to what is written in the Writings,

“Manama, emun ke eglalag ka, egkanengnengan ne matareng ka.

“God, when you(sg) speak, (it) will_be_known that you(sg) are righteous.

Ne emun ke due egsumbung keykew diye te hukumanan, egpanalu ka iya.”

And when someone charges_ you(sg) _with_wrong in court, you(sg) will_ indeed _be_victorious.”

5 Ne kema ke due egkahi, “Piru ke ka me sale ta ka egpakita te eleg ne peggukum te Manama, kene ne eleg ne eglegparan ki te Manama.” (Migpangasak a iling te ware aperu ne etew.) 6 Kene ki iya egpakakahi te iling due! Su emun ke kene ne matareng ka Manama, egmenuwen din naa te eggukum ka langun ne etew kayi te ampew te tane?

5 Perhaps someone will_say, “But if our(incl) sin is what_reveals the correct judgment of God, it is not right that we(incl) are punished by God.” (I am discussing (this) like a person without any sense (LIT without a gallbladder).) 6 We(incl) indeed can't speak like that! For if God is not righteous, how will he judge all the people here on the top of the ground?

7 Ne kema ke due man-e egkahi, “Piru ke igkapapitew pinaahi te peg-uubat ku ne layun malehet ka lalag te Manama wey egmabantug sikandin tenged kayi, mani naa te eggukuman e pad ne makasesale?” 8 Due imbayung kanami ne migkahi key kun, “Mania te kene ki eggimu te mareet eyew meupiya ka egpangkusan?” Sikandan se me talagbayung, eleg ne eglegparan.

7 Perhaps someone else will_say, “But if it is shown by means of my lying that God's words are always true and he is honored as a result of it, why am I yet judged as a sinner?” 8 Someone accused us(excl) that we(excl) [hearsay] said, “Why don't we(incl) do evil so_that good will_result?” Those accusers, (they are) fit for judging.

Ware etew ne matareng

No person is righteous

9 Na, meupiya ki naan pad se me Hudiyu te kene ne me Hudiyu? Kene! Su ingkahi kud e ne ka langun ne etew nariralem te geem te sale, Hudiyu ma wey se kene. 10 [xr]Su sumale te Kasulatan,

9 Now_then, are we(incl) Hudiyu better than non Hudiyu? No! For I already said that all people are under the power of sin, the Hudiyu and the non (Hudiyu). 10 [xr]For according to the Writings,

“Ware minsan sabeka ne etew ne matareng,

“Not even one person is righteous,

11 ware sabeka ne egpakasabut te Manama wey ware egpamitew kandin.

11 no one can understand God and none seeks him.

12 Mig-inniyuhan dan langun ka Manama wey warad karuan dan diye te kandin;

12 They all turned_away from God and they have no_more use for him;

wey ware minsan sabeka ne miggimu te meupiya.

and not even one does good.

13 [xra][xrb]Egpekeiling te egngareg ne lebeng ka abelengan dan,

13 [xra][xrb]Their throats are_like a stinking grave,

inggamit dan ka me dile dan te pegpanlimbung

they use their tongues for deceiving

wey egpekeiling te lalas te uled ka me lalag dan.

and their words are_like the venom of a snake.

14 [xr]Neelin ne masakit ne dilus ka diye te be-be dan.

14 [xr]Altogether painful curses are in their mouths.

15 [xr]Malemu re diye te kandan ka peggimatey;

15 [xr]Killing is just simple for them;

16 Egdereet sikandan wey egbayad-bayad te me etew minsan hendei sikandan egbaye.

16 They destroy and persecute people wherever they travel.

17 Ware sikandan nakataha te dalan te keupianan,

17 They don't know the path of peace,

18 [xr]wey ware pegkaaldek dan te Manama.”

18 [xr]and they have_no fear of God.”

19 Nakanengneng ki ne seeye se imbehayan te Balaud iyan perem egtuman dutu, sikan naa sikanta se me Hudiyu, kene ki egpakapangatarengan ne ware sale ta wey eggukuman ki te Manama duma te langun ne etew kayi te ampew te tane. 20 [xr]Su ware eg-isipen ne matareng diye te tangkaan te Manama pinaahi te pegtuman te Balaud. Su ka Balaud ilaan de ne due sale te etew.

19 We(incl) know that those given the Law (are) the ones who should fulfill it, and so we(incl) Hudiyu, we(incl) will_ not _be_able_to_defend (the idea) that we(incl) have_no sin and we(incl) will_be_judged by God along_with all people here on top of the ground. 20 [xr]For no one is considered righteous in the presence of God by_means of fulfilling the Law. For the Law just makes_known that a person has sin.

Ka paahi te Manama te peg-isip ne matareng te etew

The way that God considers a person righteous

21 Piru kuntee, impanengneng e te Manama ka paahi ke immenu rin te peg-isip ne matareng ka me etew, piru kene ne pinaahi te pegtuman te Balaud. Nasulat seeye ne paahi diye te Balaud ni Muwisis wey te sinulat te duma ne me prupita. 22 [xr]In-isip ne matareng te Manama ka langun ne migpalintutuu wey migsalig ki Hisu Kristu. Nekeg-iling de iya ka langun diye te kandin 23 su nakasale ka langun wey nakariyu-diyu e te kabantug te Manama. 24 Piru tenged te keupiya wey keyid-u ne indasag te Manama kanta langun, in-isip ki nikandin ne matareng pinaahi te peglekat kanta ni Kristu Hisus. 25 Impeuyan sikandin te Manama isip igpalangesa te sale ta eyew egkapasaylu ki ke egpalintutuu wey egsalig ki kandin. Ne puun due, igpakapapitew te Manama ka katareng din su imbalahad din pad dengan ka me sale te me etew wey ware din sikandan duseyi. 26 Neyimu sika te Manama eyew kuntee igpakapapitew rin ka katareng din pinaahi ki Hisus. Matareng sikandin wey eg-isipen ne matareng ka langun ne egpalintutuu wey egsalig ki Hisus.

21 But now, God has made_known the way in which he considers people to be righteous, but (it is) not by_means of fulfilling the Law. That way was_written of in the Law of Muwisis and the writings of other prophets. 22 [xr]God considers righteous all who believe and trust in Hisu Kristu. All are indeed just the same to him 23 for all have_sinned and are distanced from the greatness of God. 24 But because of the goodness and mercy that God has gifted us(incl) all with, he considered us(incl) righteous by_means of Kristu Hisus' redeeming us(incl). 25 He was_sent by God as one_who_bleeds for our(incl) sin so_that we(incl) will_be_forgiven if we(incl) believe and trust in him. And from that, God demonstrated his righteousness for he ignored the sins of people long_ago and he did not condemn them. 26 God did that so_that now he can demonstrate his righteousness by_means of Hisus. He is righteous and all are_considered righteous who believe and trust in Hisus.

27 Purisu kene ki egpakapeggasal te pegkamatareng ta su in-isip ki nikandin ne matareng tenged te pegpalintutuu ta ki Hisu Kristu wey kene ne tenged te pegtuman ta te Balaud. 28 Su migsuman-suman key ne in-isip ne matareng te Manama ka etew tenged te pegpalintutuu, kene ne tenged te pegtuman te Balaud. 29 Ne kene ne Manama re sikandin te me Hudiyu su Manama red degma sikandin te kene ne me Hudiyu, 30 [xr]su sabsabeka re ka Manama. Ne elin din eg-isipen ne matareng ka me Hudiyu wey ka kene ne me Hudiyu tenged de te pegpalintutuu ran. 31 Ne puun te pegpalintutuu ta, indapig te naan e ka Balaud? Ware, su nasi te re iya impamalehetan ka Balaud.

27 Therefore we(incl) are_ not _able_to_boast of our(incl) righteousness because he considers us(incl) righteous as a result of our(incl) faith in Hisu Kristu and not by_means of our(incl) fulfilling the Law. 28 For we(excl) consider/think that a person is considered righteous by God by_means of faith, not by_means of fulfilling the Law. 29 And he is not only the God of the Hudiyu because he is also God of the non Hudiyu, 30 [xr]for God is just one. And he considers righteous both the Hudiyu and the Gentiles only as a result of their faith. 31 And from our(incl) faith, have we(incl) then set_aside the Law? No, for instead we(incl) indeed confirmed the Law.

Ka peg-isip te Manama ki Abraham ne matareng tenged te pegpalintutuu rin

Abraham was_considered righteous by God because of his faith

41 Nekey naa ka igkalalag ta meyitenged te neula-ula ni Abraham ne apu ney te me Hudiyu? 2 Ne emun ke in-isip te Manama ne matareng si Abraham pinaahi te hinimuwan din, due perem igpakapeggasal rin. Piru ka malehet, ware igpakapeggasal rin diye te tangkaan te Manama. 3 [xr]Su nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Migpalintutuu si Abraham te Manama, sikan naa ka in-isip sikandin ne matareng te Manama.” 4 Egsuulan ka etew ne egtrabahu, piru kene egkaayun ne eg-isipen ne dasag ka insuul kandin su bayad te pegtrabahu rin. 5 Piru ka etew ne ware miggimu te minsan nekey eyew egkaluwas piru migsalig te Manama ne eg-isip ne matareng te seeye se me etew ne kene pad eg-ikul te Manama, eg-isipen sikandin ne matareng tenged te pegpalintutuu rin. 6 Sikan ded ka igpasabut ni Dabid te ingkahi rin ne egpanalanginan ka etew ne in-isip ne matareng te Manama, kene ne tenged te hinimuwan din:

41 What will we(incl) say concerning the fate of Abraham our(excl) grandparent of the Hudiyu? 2 Now if God considered Abraham righteous by_means of his deeds, there would_be something_ he _is_able_to_boast_about. But the truth (is), there_is_nothing he is able_to_boast_about in the presence of God. 3 [xr]For it is written in the Writings that goes_like_this, “Abraham believed God, and so he was_considered righteous by God.” 4 A person who works is paid_wages, but it's_ not _possible that what is paid to him will_be_considered a gift for it is payment for his working. 5 But the person who does not do anything in_order to be_saved but trusts in God who considers as righteous those people who are not yet following God, he is considered righteous as a result of his faith. 6 That's what Dabid made_known when he said that a person whom God considers righteous is blessed, not as a result of his deeds:

7 [xr]“Egpanalanginan seeye se impasaylu e te Manama,

7 [xr]“Those who are forgiven by God are_blessed,

wey in-awe e ka me sale!

and (their) sins have_been_removed!

8 Egpanalanginan ka etew ne inlingawan e ka sale din te Magbebaye ne Manama!”

8 The person whose sin is forgotten by Lord God is blessed!”

9 Na, kandan naan de te me Hudiyu ne nenatulian ka sika ne panalangin, wey ke lagkes e degma ka kene ne me Hudiyu ne ware nenatulii? Nakahi kud e ne in-isip ne matareng si Abraham te Manama tenged de te pegpalintutuu rin. 10 Ken-u naa seeye neyitabu? Te timpu naa ne natulian e si Abraham wey ke ware pad sikandin natulii? Neyitabu seeye te timpu ne ware pad sikandin natulii. 11 [xr]Intulian sikandin isip tuus ne matareng e tenged te pegpalintutuu rin te ware pad sikandin natulii. Sikan naa ka neyimu sikandin ne amey te langun ne migpalintutuu ne ware pad natulii eyew eg-isipen degma te Manama ne matareng sikandan. 12 Ne amey degma si Abraham te nenatulian, kene ne puun de su nenatulian sikandan, ke kene, tenged su mig-iling degma sikandan te pegpalintutuu te amey ney ne si Abraham te ware pad natulii.

9 Now_then, is that blessing only for those Hudiyu who have_been_circumcised, or (are) the non Hudiyu who have_ not _been_circumcised also included? I already said that Abraham was_considered righteous by God only as a result of his faith. 10 When did that happen? (Was it) at the time that Abraham was already circumcised or was he not yet circumcised? That happened at the time that he was not yet circumcised. 11 [xr]He was circumcised as a sign that (he was) already righteous as a result of his faith when he had_ not yet _been_circumcised. And so he became a father of all who believe and are not yet circumcised so_that God will_ also _consider that they are righteous. 12 And Abraham is also the father of the circumcised, not just because they are cirumcised, but rather, because they also imitate the faith of our(excl) father Abraham when (he was) not yet circumcised.

Ka saad te Manama ne egkarawat pinaahi te pegpalintutuu

The promise of God received by_means of faith

13 [xr]Iyan saad te Manama diye te ki Abraham wey te me kabuhalan din ne egkaangken dan ka kalibutan. Ne kene ne tenged te pegtuman din te Balaud ka egpuunan te sika ne saad, ke kene, tenged te pegpalintutuu wey in-isip sikandin ne matareng te Manama. 14 [xr]Su emun ke iyan de egpakaangken te saad te Manama ka migtuman te Balaud, egkeyimu ne ware karuan te pegpalintutuu ta wey te saad te Manama. 15 Su ka Balaud ka egpuunan ne egdusaan te Manama ka me etew. Ke ware balaud, ware degma egkasupak te me etew.

13 [xr]The promise of God to Abraham and his descendants is they will_possess the world. And the source of that promise is not the result of his obeying the Law, but rather, the result of faith and (that) he was_considered righteous by God. 14 [xr]For if only those who fulfill the Law are able_to_receive the promise of God, our(incl) faith and God's promise become useless. 15 For the Law is the source of God's severely_punishing people. If there_was_no law, there would also be nothing for people to rebel_against.

16 [xr]Purisu tenged de te pegpalintutuu ne egkarawat te me etew ka insaad te Manama eyew pamalehet ne inggimu rin sika isip dasag diye te me kabuhalan ni Abraham. Ka saad te Manama kene ne para re te me Hudiyu ne migtuman te Balaud, ke kene, egkarawat iya te langun ne migpalintutuu iling ki Abraham su sikandin ka amey te langun ne migpalintutuu. 17 [xr]Su due nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue, “Inggimu ku sikeykew ne amey te me etew puun te masulug ne me nasud.” Ne natuman sika su neyimu si Abraham ne amey ta langun diye te tangkaan te Manama ne impalintutuuwan din. Sikandin ka Manama ne egpekeuyag te me minatey wey egpakakahi ne duen e ka ware pad. 18 [xr]Migpalintutuu si Abraham wey migpallateng te insaad kandin te Manama minsan hendue te kenad egkatuman. Sikan naa ka neyimu sikandin ne amey te me etew puun te masulug ne me nasud sumale te ingkahi kandin te Manama ne miggenendue, “Egpekeiling kasulug te me bituen diye te langit ka me kabuhalan nu.” 19 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, egkabuyag e si Abraham wey hendue te kenad egpakaanak su egmahatus (100) e ka idad din. Nakataha degma sikandin ne kenad eg-anak ka asawa rin ne si Sara, piru ware sikandin mig-engked ka migpalintutuu. 20 Ware sikandin migduwa-ruwa ne egkatuman ka insaad te Manama kandin wey nasi de iya neehet ka pegpalintutuu rin, wey insaye din ka Manama. 21 Nasabeka ka suman-suman din ne ka Manama egpakatuman iya te insaad din. 22 Purisu tenged te sika ne pegpalintutuu, in-isip sikandin ne matareng te Manama. 23 Ne kene ne ki Abraham de ka insulat ne lalag ne miggenendue, “In-isip sikandin ne matareng,” 24 ke kene, nalagkes ki degma se egpalintutuu wey egsalig te Manama ne mig-uyag te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisus. 25 [xr]Impeyimatayan si Hisus tenged te me sale ta wey in-uyag sikandin eyew eg-isipen ki ne matareng te Manama.

16 [xr]Therefore it is only because of faith that people receive what God promised in_order to confirm that he did that as a gift to the descendants of Abraham. The promise of God is not only for the Hudiyu who fulfill the Law, but rather, all who believe like Abraham will_ indeed _receive (it) for he is the father of all who believe. 17 [xr]For it is written in the Writings like_this, “I made you(sg) the father of people of many nations.” And this was fulfilled because Abraham became the father of all of us(incl) in the presence of God in whom he believed. He (is) the God who is able_to_give_life to corpses and is able_to_say that what is not yet already is. 18 [xr]Abraham believed and expected what was promised to him by God even_though (it was) as if (it) no_longer would_be_fulfilled. And so he became the father of people of many nations according to what God told him like_this, “Your(sg) descendants will_be_like the number of stars in the sky.” 19 [xr]At that time, Abraham was already old and it was like he could no_longer beget_children for his age was already one-hundred (100). He also understood that his spouse Sara could no_longer beget_children, but he did not stop believing. 20 He did not have_second_thoughts that what God had_promised to him would_be_fulfilled and instead his faith only truly tightened, and he praised God. 21 He was unwavering (LIT his thinking was one) that God is indeed able_to_fulfill what he promised. 22 Therefore because of that faith, he was_considered righteous by God. 23 And the words that were_written like this were not only for Abraham, “He was_considered righteous,” 24 but rather, we(incl) are also included who believe and trust in God who gave_life to our(incl) Lord Hisus. 25 [xr]Hisus was caused_to_be_killed because of our(incl) sins and he was_given_life so_that we(incl) would_be_considered righteous by God.

Ka pegkahale tenged te pegkamatareng

Joy as a result of righteousness

51 Purisu tenged su in-isip kid ne matareng te Manama tenged te pegpalintutuu ta, nekeg-uli e ka meupiya ne geyinawa ta diye te kandin pinaahi te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu. 2 Ne pinaahi te pegpalintutuu ta diye te kandin, nakaneem-neem ki te seini se keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama ne migdesdesenan tad e. Ne egkahale ki man-e te impallateng ta ne egpakasawit te katelesan te Manama. 3 Ne kene ne sikan de, su igkahale ta degma minsan due me pegbayad-bayad kanta su egpakabasbas sika kanta ne egkateu ne eg-antus. 4 Ne emun ke egkateu kid ne eg-antus, egkeehet e ka pegpalintutuu ta. Ne emun ke egkeehet e ka pegpalintutuu ta, egpakapallateng kid ne egpakasawit te katelesan te Manama. 5 Kene ki egkeyilawan te impallateng ta su nakapamule e ka geyinawa te Manama kayi te pusung ta pinaahi te Panisingan din ne imbehey rin kanta.

51 Therefore since we(incl) are_considered righteous by God as a result of our(incl) faith, our(incl) loving_relationship (LIT good breath) with him is restored_[reciprocally] by_means of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu. 2 And by_means of our(incl) faith in him, we(incl) have tasted this goodness and mercy of God which we(incl) firmly_hold_onto. We(incl) are also happy in our(incl) expectation of participating in the splendor of God. 3 And not only that, for we(incl) are also happy even_though we(incl) have persecutions for they are able_to_train us(incl) to be adept at suffering/enduring. 4 And if we(incl) are adept at suffering, our(incl) faith becomes tightened. And if our(incl) faith becomes tightened, we(incl) are able_to_expect to participate in God's splendor. 5 We(incl) will_ not _be_shamed by what_ we(incl) _hope_for because the love of God has been_planted here in our(incl) hearts by_means of his Spirit whom he gave us(incl).

6 Te eleg ne timpu taheed te kene ki pad egpekeyimu te igkeupii te Manama, migpeyimatey si Kristu para te me etew ne kene eg-ikul te Manama. 7 Na, ware buwa etew ne egpeyimatey para te matareng ne etew, piru kema ke duen buwa etew ne kene egkaaldek ne egpeyimatey para te meupiya ne etew. 8 Piru impapitew te Manama ka dakel ne geyinawa rin kanta su migpatey si Kristu para kanta te makasesale ki pad te seeye ne timpu.

6 At the right time while we(incl) were not yet able_to_do what God desired, Kristu was caused_to_be_killed for people who do not follow/imitate God. 7 Now_then, maybe no person will_allow himself to be_killed (LIT cause_to_be_killed) for a righteous person, but perhaps there might be a person who is not afraid to allow himself to be_killed (LIT cause_to_be_killed) for a good person. 8 But God revealed his great love for us(incl) because Hisus allowed himself to be_killed for us(incl) who were still sinners at that time.

9 Ne puun su in-isip kid te Manama ne matareng pinaahi te langesa ni Kristu, wey ki naan pa iya kene egluwasen nikandin ligkat te legpad te Manama keureme. 10 Su minsan kuntere ki pad dengan te Manama, piru nekeg-uli ded ka meupiya ne geyinawa ta kandin pinaahi te kamatayen te Anak din. Ne puun su nekeg-uli ded ka meupiya ne geyinawa ta kandin, wey ki naan pa iya kene egkaluwas keureme te neuyag man ded si Kristu. 11 Ne kene ne sikan de, su imbehayan ki te Manama te kahale tenged te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu ne iyan egpuunan ne nekeg-uli ka meupiya ne geyinawa ta te Manama.

9 And since we(incl) are_considered righteous by God by_means of the blood of Kristu, even_more yet will we(incl) be_saved (LIT how_much yet indeed we(incl) can't be_saved) by him from the punishment of God in_the_future. 10 For although we(incl) were formerly still enemies of God, yet our(incl) love (LIT good breath) was restored_[reciprocally] with him by_means of the death of his Child. And since our(incl) love was restored_[reciprocally] with him, even_more yet will we(incl) be_saved (LIT how_much yet indeed we(incl) can't be_saved) in_the_future since Kristu has come_alive. 11 And not only that, for God has_given us(incl) joy because of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu who is the source whereby our(incl) love (LIT good breath) was restored_[reciprocally] with God.

Ka intamanan te inggimu ni Adan wey te inggimu ni Kristu

The result of what Adan did and what Kristu did

12 [xr]Ne nakaseled ka sale kayi te ampew te tane pinaahi ki Adan, wey ka sale mig-uyan te kamatayen, wey ka langun egbaye te kamatayen su nakasale ka langun ne etew. 13 Minsan tapey e kayi te ampew te tane ka sale te ware pad ibehey ka Balaud, piru ware neila su ware Balaud. 14 Piru minsan pad iling due, narahabas ka langun namatey puun pad te timpu ni Adan taman te timpu ni Muwisis, minsan seeye se kene ne iling ka sale te ki Adan ne migsupak te Manama.

12 [xr]Sin entered the world (LIT top of the ground) by_means of Adan, and sin brought death, and everyone goes_through death because all people have_sinned. 13 Although sin was here in the world long_ago when the Law had_ not yet _been_given, yet (it) was not recognized because there_was_no Law. 14 But even_though it is like that, everyone without_exception died from the time of Adan until the time of Muwisis, even those whose sin was not like Adan's who disobeyed God.

Si Adan ka egkapahunsilingan te nakasinundul ne si Kristu.15 Piru ware nekeg-iling ka sale ni Adan wey ka indasag te Manama. Su masulug ka nammatey tenged te sale te sabeka ne etew, piru subla pad iya ne dakel ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama wey ka dasag din diye te masulug ne me etew pinaahi te keupiya wey keyid-u te sabeka ne etew ne si Hisu Kristu. 16 Ne ware degma nekeg-iling ka egpangkusan te sale ni Adan wey te indasag te Manama. Su egkarahabas ka me etew ne eglegparan tenged te sale ni Adan, piru egkapasaylu ka me etew te dakel ne sale dan wey eg-isipen ne matareng tenged te dasag te Manama. 17 Egkarahabas ka langun egpatey tenged te sale te sabeka ne etew. Ne tenged degma te sabeka ne etew ne si Hisu Kristu, subla pad iya ne egkabayangan te umul ne ware egtamanan seeye se nakarawat te dakel ne keyid-u te Manama wey te katareng ne indasag din.

Adan can be_compared_to the one_who_followed who is Kristu.15 But the sin of Adan and the gift of God (are) not the same. For many died as a result of the sin of one person, but much greater indeed is the goodness and mercy of God and his gift to many people by_means of the goodness and mercy of one person who is Hisu Kristu. 16 And the outcome of the sin of Adan was also not the same as what God gave. For without_exception people are punished as a result of the sin of Adan, but people are forgiven their great sin and are_considered righteous as a result of the gift of God. 17 Without_exception all die because of the sin of one person. And also because of one person Hisu Kristu, those who received the great mercy of God and the righteousness that he gifted are indeed much more abundantly_supplied with life without end.

18 Purisu tenged te sale te sabeka ne etew, egkarahabas te legpad ka langun ne etew, ne tenged degma te matareng ne himu te sabeka ne etew ne si Kristu, eg-isipen ded ne matareng ka me etew wey egpakarawat te umul ne ware egtamanan. 19 Tenged te pegsupak te sabeka ne etew, masulug ka neyimu ne makasesale. Ne tenged degma te pegtuman te sabeka ne etew, masulug ka egkeyimu ne matareng.

18 Therefore as a result of the sin of one person, without_exception all are punished, and as a result also of the righteous work of one person who is Kristu, people are_considered righteous and are able_to_receive life without end. 19 As a result of the disobedience of one person, many became sinners. And as a result also of the obedience of one person, many will_become righteous.

20 Imbehey te Manama ka Balaud eyew egkanengnengan te me etew ne dakel ka sale dan. Tenged due, nasi de iya migdakel ka sale, piru nanasnasian de iya degma migdakel ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama. 21 Ne eyew iling te sale ne egpakarahabas te langun ne egpatey, ka keyid-u degma te Manama egpakarahabas te me etew ne egkeisip ne matareng wey egpakarawat te umul ne ware egtamanan pinaahi te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu.

20 God gave the Law in_order that people will_be_aware that their sin(s) were big/great. Because of it, sin even increased, but the goodness and mercy of God also increased all_the_more. 21 And so_that as sin is able_to_cause_all_without_exception to die, the mercy of God also is able_to_cause_ people _without_exception to be_considered righteous and able_to_receive life without end by_means of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu.

Ka pegpatey wey pegkeuyag due ki Kristu

Death and resurrection in Kristu

61 Na, nekey naa ka igkalalag ta? Egpabulus ki naa ka eggimu te sale eyew egkanasnasian egdakel ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Manama? 2 Kene! Su meyitenged te sale, nekeiling te migpatey kid due wey kene kid egpabulus eggimu te sale. 3 Nanengnengan niyud ne sikanta langun se nabewutismuwan e ne nasabeke e due ki Kristu Hisus, in-isip kid ne nakalagkes degma kandin te migpatey. 4 [xr]Su te nabewutismuwan kid e, nakalagkes kid ki Kristu te inlebeng eyew eg-ugpe ki degma te iyam ne umul iling te pegkeuyag ni Kristu pinaahi te karesen te Amey. 5 Su emun ke nakalagkes kid kandin te migpatey, egpakalagkes ki red man-e te pegkeuyag din. 6 Su nanengnengan ta ne inlansang e te krus ka tapey ne pegkeetew ta duma kandin eyew egkareetan e ka lawa ta ne makasesale wey kene kid e egkeuripen te sale. 7 Su kenad eg-utengan te sale ka etew ne migpatey e. 8 Ne emun ke nakalagkes kid ki Kristu te migpatey, egpalintutuu ki ne egkalagkes ki degma te umul rin. 9 Su nanengnengan ta ne kenad egpatey pad eg-abey si Kristu puun su neuyag e sikandin, wey kenad sikandin eg-utengan te kamatayen. 10 Su kasabeka re sikandin migpatey eyew te peg-awe te sale wey kenad egkaabey pad. Piru ka peg-ugpe din kuntee para te pegpamakey te Manama. 11 Purisu is-isipa niyu degma ne nekeiling te migpatey kew e wey kenad egpakasale[fn] piru neuyag kew eyew egpamakey te Manama tenged te pegsabeka niyu ki Kristu Hisus.

61 Now_then, what will we(incl) say? Will we(incl) continue to do sin so_that the goodness and mercy of God will_increase even_more? 2 No! For regarding sin, (it is) like we(incl) died to it and we(incl) can't continue to commit sin. 3 You(pl) know that we(incl) all who were baptized and became_one in Kristu Hisus, (it's) considered that we(incl) are also included with him in dying. 4 [xr]For when we(incl) were baptized, we(incl) were_included in Kristu's burial so_that we(incl) will_ also _live a new life like the resurrection of Kristu by_means of the greatness/might of the Father. 5 For if we(incl) are included with him in dying, we(incl) will_ also _be_included in his_coming_to_life_again. 6 For we(incl) understand that our(incl) former self/personhood was nailed to a cross along_with him so_that our(incl) sinful bodies would_be_destroyed and we(incl) will_ no_longer _be_enslaved to sin. 7 For the person who has died can no_longer be ruled by sin (LIT cut by sin). 8 And if we(incl) are included with Kristu in death, we(incl) believe that we(incl) will_ also _be_included in his life. 9 For we(incl) understand that Kristu will_ no_longer _die again because he has already come_alive, and he will_ no_longer _be_ruled by death (LIT cut by death). 10 For he died only once in_order to remove sin and (it) will_ no_longer _be_repeated. But his living today is for service to God. 11 Therefore also consider(pl) that you(pl) (are) the same as dead already and no_longer able_to_sin[fn] but raised_to_life(pl) in_order to serve God as a result of your(pl) oneness with Kristu Hisus.

12 Sikan naa, kene niyu paruyun-duyuni ka sale ne egmandu kaniyu eyew kene kew egpakaruma-ruma te mareet ne igkeupii te lawa niyu. 13 Kene niyu paruyun-duyuni ne egpakasale ka minsan nekey ne baad te lawa niyu, ke kene, paruyun-duyuni niyu ka Manama ne eggamit te lawa niyu isip me etew ne nammatey piru in-uyag e. Ne ipahamit niyu te Manama ka intiru ne lawa niyu te matareng ne hinimuwan. 14 Su ka sale, kenad egmandu kaniyu tenged su ware kew nariralem te Balaud, ke kene, nariralem kew e te keyid-u.

12 And so, don't(pl) indulge sin to rule_over you(pl) so_that you(pl) don't comply with the evil that your(pl) bodies desire. 13 Don't(pl) indulge any part of your(pl) bodies to sin, but rather, you(pl) allow God to use your(pl) bodies as people who died but were raised_to_life. And allow_ God _to_use(pl) the entire body for righteous deeds. 14 For sin, (it) no_longer rules_over you(pl) because you(pl) are not under the Law, but rather, you(pl) are under mercy.

Ka eggimu te matareng

The (ones) doing righteousness

15 Nekey naan e, eggimu ki naan ded te sale su ware ki nariralem te Balaud, ke kene, te keyid-u? Kene! 16 Ware kew bes nakataha ne emun ke egpeiluk-iluk kew te senge-etew isip matinumanen ne uripen, sikandin iya ka ahalen niyu? Sikan naa, emun ke egparuyun-duyun kew te sale, uripen kew iya te sale ne diye egpangkus te kamatayen. Ne emun egpeuripen kew eyew te pegtuman te Manama, egkeyimu kew ne matareng. 17 Piru migpasalamat a te Manama su sikaniyu se neuripen dengan te sale, malehet ne migmatinumanen e kuntee te kamalehetan ne impanulu kaniyu. 18 Nakaawe kew e puun te sale wey neyimu ne uripen te pegkamatareng. 19 Iyan ku re inggamit ka pahunsilingan ne mahaan de egkasabut, su malebud pad ka isip niyu. Imparuyun-duyunan niyu dengan ka intiru ne lawa niyu ne eggimu te malligsem wey migpanaman-taman kew miggimu te mareet. Piru kuntee, iparuyun-duyun niyu ka intiru ne lawa niyu te pegkamatareng eyew egmatulus kew.

15 What then, should we(incl) just commit sin because we(incl) are not under the Law, but rather, mercy? No! 16 Do you(pl) not [emphasis] know that if you(pl) are submitted to one person as a faithful slave, he is indeed your(pl) master? So then, if you(pl) indulge sin, you(pl) are indeed a slave to sin which results in death. And if you(pl) are enslaved for obedience to God, you(pl) will_become righteous. 17 But I thank God because you(pl) who were enslaved to sin before, (you) have now truly become_faithful to the truth that was taught to you(pl). 18 You(pl) have_been_freed from sin and have become slave(s) to righteousness. 19 I just used an illustration easy to understand, because your(pl) mind/thinking is still weak (LIT immature). Formerly you(pl) submitted your(pl) entire bodies to do indecent_things and you(pl) did evil to_the_full_extent. But now, submit(pl) your(pl) entire bodies to righteousness so_that you(pl) will_be_holy.

20 Su kene kew pad dengan ne uripen te pegkamatareng te neuripen kew pad te sale. 21 Ne nekey naa ka meupiya ne egkaangey niyu te maddeet ne nangimu niyu dengan ne ingkeyilew niyud kuntee? Ware iya su kamatayen ka egpangkusan due. 22 Piru kuntee te nakaawe kew e puun te sale wey neyimu kew e ne uripen te Manama, ka meupiya ne egkaangey niyu iyan ka pegkamatulus ne egpangkus diye te umul ne ware egtamanan. 23 Su iyan bayad te peggimu te sale ka kamatayen, piru iyan dasag te Manama ka umul ne ware egtamanan tenged te pegsabeka ta ki Kristu Hisus ne Magbebaye ta.

20 For you(pl) were not formerly slaves of righteousness when you(pl) were yet enslaved by sin. 21 And what good_thing will you(pl) get from the wicked_things that you(pl) did before that you(pl) are now ashamed of? Indeed nothing for death is the outcome of that. 22 But now that you(pl) have_been_freed from sin and you(pl) have become slaves of God, the good_thing that you(pl) get is the holiness that will_result in life without end. 23 For the payment for committing sin is death, but the gift of God is life without end resulting from our(incl) oneness with Kristu Hisus who is our(incl) Lord.

Ware kid neuripen te Balaud

We(incl) are no_longer enslaved to the Law

71 Me suled, nakanengneng a ne egpakasabut kew iya te iglalag ku su nakataha kew te Balaud. Natahaan niyu ne duen de katenged te Balaud diye te etew ke manekal pad sikandin. 2 Iyan panunggilingan ka manggiasawe e ne malitan ne egkeyiketan pad diye te asawa rin taheed te manekal pad ka iglukes din. Piru ke egpatey e ka asawa rin, kenad sikandin egkeyiketan te balaud te pegpaasaweey. 3 Purisu egpakapanlibug ka malitan ke eg-asawa sikandin te manekal pad ka asawa rin. Piru ke egpatey e, kenad sikandin egkeyiketan te balaud te pegpaasaweey wey kenad egpakapanlibug ke egbalew-balew sikandin eg-asawa. 4 Iling naan ded due me suled, nakaawe kew e te Balaud pinaahi te pegkalagkes niyu ki Kristu te migpatey. Ne nasakup kid e nikandin te neuyag ded eyew mabehas ka pegpamakey ta te Manama. 5 Su dengan te egparuyun-duyunan te pad ka igkeupii te lawa ta ne makasesale, nasi de iya neulat ka ibeg ta te malindit ne igkeupii te lawa ta te nakanengneng kid e te Balaud, ne sika diye egpangkus te kamatayen. 6 Piru ware kid e kuntee neyiketi te Balaud su migpatey kid due te mig-uripen dengan kanta. Ka pegpamakey ta kuntee te Manama kenad ne pinaahi te nasulat ne Balaud, ke kene, pinaahi te iyam ne peg-ugpe ne egpuun te Panisingan te Manama.

71 Brothers, I know that you(pl) will_ indeed _understand what_ I _will_say because you(pl) know the Law. You(pl) know that the Law still has authority over a person if he is still alive (LIT strong). 2 An example of that is a woman who is already married who is still tied to her spouse while her husband is still alive (LIT strong). But if her spouse dies, she is no_longer tied by the law of marriage. 3 Therefore the woman will_commit_adultery if she marries while her spouse is still alive. But if (he) is already dead, she is no_longer tied by the law of marriage and will_ no_longer _commit_adultery if she remarries. 4 Like that brothers, you(pl) were freed from the Law by_means of your(pl) inclusion with Kristu in dying. And we(incl) belong to him who was raised_to_life so_that our(incl) serving of God is fruitful. 5 For before when we(incl) still indulged the desires of our(incl) sinful bodies, our(incl) cravings for filthy_things that our(incl) bodies desired instead actually worsened when we(incl) understood the Law, and that will_result in death. 6 But we(incl) are now no_longer tied to the Law for we(incl) have died to what enslaved us(incl) before. Our(incl) service to God today is no_longer by_means of what was_written in the Law, but rather, by_means of new living from the Spirit of God.

Egkeilaan ka sale pinaahi te Balaud

Sin is recognized by_means of the Law

7 [xr]Na, nekey naa ka igkalalag ta? Egpakakahi ki naa te mareet ka Balaud? Kene! Su wara a perem nakataha ke nekey ka sale ke ware Balaud. Wara a nakataha ke nekey ka pegkeimma ke ware pa migkahi ka Balaud, “Kene ka egkeimma!” 8 Piru tenged te sale ne tapey kayi te keddi, nasi e re iya egkanasnasian ne egkeimma tenged te sika ne suhu. Su emun ke ware Balaud, ware degma geem te sale. 9 Manekal e pad dengan te ware e pad nakasabut te Balaud, piru te nakasabut ad e, hendue te naalimukawan ad te tapey ne pegkamakasesale ku 10 wey iling te migpatey ad e diye te Manama. Sikan naa ka Balaud ne iyan perem egbehey te umul, iyan nasi migpuunan te kamatayen ku. 11 [xr]Su pinaahi te Balaud, migpalimmakut ka sale ne tapey e kayi te keddi eyew peglimbung keddi, wey newukuman ad te Balaud ne egpatey.

7 [xr]Now_then, what will we(incl) say? Can we(incl) say that the Law is evil? No! For I would not know what sin is if there_was_no Law. I would not know what coveting is if the Law did not say, “Don't(sg) covet!” 8 But as a result of the sin that was already in me, instead I really coveted even_more because of that command. For if there_is_no Law, sin also has no power. 9 I was alive (LIT strong) before when I did not yet know the Law, but when I knew (it), (it was) like I was revived to my former sinfulness 10 and it was like I died to God. And so the Law that is what should give life, it instead was the source of my death. 11 [xr]For by_means of the Law, the sin already in me found_opportunity to deceive me, and the Law condemned me to die.

12 Sikan naa, matulus ka Balaud wey matareng wey meupiya ka langun ne suhu ne due te Balaud. 13 Ne migpasabut naa ne iyan nakapatey keddi ka meupiya? Kene! Su iyan ka sale ne tapey e kayi te keddi, wey inggamit de ka meupiya eyew egkamelmelehan ne mareet ka sale. Ne pinaahi te Balaud, egkakita ka subla ne kareet te sale.

12 So_then, the Law is holy and all of the commandments in the Law are righteous and good. 13 Does this mean that what killed me is a good_thing? No! It was the sin already in me, and he just used what is good so_that sin would_be clearly_seen as evil. And by_means of the Law, the extreme wickedness of sin is seen.

Ka samuk diye te diralem ta

The conflict inside us(incl)

14 Nanengnengan ta ne meupiya ka Balaud su diye migpuun te Manama. Piru etew e re ne egpakasale wey iling te imbelegye isip uripen te sale. 15 [xr]Neinu-inu a te egkeyimu ku, su kene ku egkeyimu ka igkeupii ku ne eggimuwen, ke kene, iyan ku mule egkeyimu ka igkeepes ku. 16 Sikan naa, emun ke igkeepes ku ka egkeyimu ku ne mareet, eg-uyun a ne meupiya ka Balaud. 17 Sikan naa ka kene ne sikeddi ka eggimu kayi, ke kene, ka sale ne tapey e kayi te keddiey. 18 Su nakanengneng a ne ware meupiya kayi te lawa ku ne makasesale, tenged su minsan egkeupian a ne eggimu te meupiya piru kene ku egkeyimu. 19 Su kene ku egkeyimu ka meupiya ne igkeupii ku ne eggimuwen, ke kene, iyan ku egkeyimu ka mareet ne igkeepes ku ne eggimuwen. 20 Sikan naa, emun ke eggimuwen ku ka igkeepes ku, kenad ne sikeddi pad ka eggimu due su ka sale e ne tapey e kayi te keddi.

14 We(incl) know that the Law is good for it is from God. But I am only a person/human who sins and (it is) like (I am) sold as a slave of sin. 15 [xr]I am surprised at what_ I _do, for I do not do what_ I _want to do, but rather, what_ I _do instead is what_ I _dislike. 16 So_then, if I dislike the evil that I am doing, I agree that the Law is good. 17 And so it is not I who do this, but rather, the sin that is already in me. 18 For I know that there_is_no good_thing in my sinful body, because even_though I want to do good_things yet I do not do (them). 19 For I do not do the good_things that I want to do, but rather, what_ I _do is the evil that I dislike to do. 20 And so, if I do what_ I _dislike, I am no_longer the one_who_is_doing it for (it is) the sin that is already in me.

21 Purisu nanengnengan ku seini ne kamalehetan: te timpu ne egkeupian a ne eggimu te meupiya, due iya degma ka mareet ne igkeupii te lawa ku. 22 Su amana iya ingkahale te pusung ku ka Balaud te Manama. 23 Piru naheram ku ne due lein ne balaud kayi te lawa ku ne migpakig-ehet te Balaud ne igkeupii te suman-suman ku. Tenged due, neuripen a te sale ne kayi te keddiey. 24 Mekeyid-u-hid-u a amana! Hentew buwa ka egluwas keddiey puun te lawa ku ne eggukuman ne egpatey? 25 Salamat te Manama ne nakaluwas keddi pinaahi te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu.

21 Therefore I know this truth: at the time that I want to do good_things, the evil that my body desires is indeed also there. 22 For the Law of God really pleases my heart greatly. 23 But I feel that there_is a different law in my body that fights_against the Law that my mind likes. Because of that, I enslaved of the sin that is here in me. 24 I am much to_be_pitied! Who can_save me from my body that is judged to die? 25 Thanks to God who saved me by_means of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu.

Na, egkeupian ka suman-suman ku ne egtuman te Balaud te Manama, piru iyan ku egkatuman ka mareet ne igkeupii te lawa ku ne makasesale.

Now_then, my mind wants to fulfill the Law of God, but what_ I _fulfill is the evil desires of my sinful body.

Ka pegparuma-ruma ta te Panisingan te Manama

Our(incl) compliance to the Spirit of God

81 Purisu kenad e ne likes te dusa te Manama seeye se nasabeke e ki Kristu Hisus. 2 Su tenged te pegsabeka ta ki Kristu Hisus, ka Panisingan te Manama ne egbehey te umul iyan nakapaawe kanta puun te Balaud ne migbehey te geem te sale ne diye egpangkus te kamatayen. 3 Kene ki igpakapaawe te Balaud puun te geem te sale su mahuye ki tenged te makasesale ne lawa ta. Piru inggimu te Manama ka kene egkeyimu te Balaud. Impeendini rin ka Anak din ne due lawa iling te etew ne makasesale eyew igpalangesa te sale ta. Ne pinaahi te lawa rin, nakaawe ki puun te geem te sale 4 eyew egkatuman kayi te kanta ka matareng ne suhu te Balaud. Su ware kid migparuma-ruma te makasesale ne lawa ta, ke kene, te Panisingan te Manama. 5 Su seeye se migparuma-ruma te makasesale ne lawa ran, iyan dan de iya egsumsumanen ka mareet ne igkeupii te lawa ran. Piru seeye se migparuma-ruma te Panisingan te Manama, iyan dan egsumsumanen ka igkeupii rin. 6 Emun ke iyan diye dapit te suman-suman te etew ka igkeupii te lawa rin ne makasesale, diye sika egpangkus te kamatayen, piru emun ke iyan diye dapit te suman-suman din ka Panisingan te Manama, egkeuyag sikandin te ware egtamanan wey due keupianan. 7 Su kuntere te Manama ka etew ne iyan diye dapit te suman-suman din ka igkeupii te lawa rin ne makasesale, su kene sikandin egtuman te Balaud te Manama wey kene iya sikandin egpakatuman kayi. 8 Ne seeye se migparuma-ruma te igkeupii te lawa ran ne makasesale, kene egpakapahale te Manama.

81 Therefore those who became_one with Kristu Hisus are no_longer worthy of God's severe_punishment. 2 Because of our(incl) oneness with Kristu Hisus, the Spirit of God who gives life is what frees us(incl) from the Law that gave power to sin which results in death. 3 We(incl) can't be freed from the power of sin by the Law for we(incl) are weak as a result of our(incl) sinful bodies. But God did what the Law can't do. He sent his Child with a body like people who are sinners in_order to bleed for our(incl) sin. And by_means of his body, we(incl) were freed from the power of sin 4 so_that the righteous command of the Law will_be_fulfilled in us(incl). For we(incl) no_longer comply with our(incl) sinful bodies, but rather, the Spirit of God. 5 For those who comply with their sinful bodies, what they think (about) is just the evil desires of their bodies. But those who comply with the Spirit of God, what they think (about) is his desires. 6 If what is near (LIT on the other side) to the thinking of a person is what his sinful body desires, that will result in death, but if what is near to his thinking is the Spirit of God, he will_live without end and have peace. 7 For the person whose desires of his sinful body are near to his thinking is an enemy of God, for he does not fulfill the Law of God and he indeed is not able_to_fulfill it. 8 And those who comply with the desires of their sinful bodies, (they) are_ not _able_to_please God.

9 Piru sikaniyu, ware kew e migparuma-ruma te igkeupii te lawa niyu ne makasesale, ke kene, iyan niyud imparumdumaan ka Panisingan te Manama ke duen e sikandin te kaniyu. Piru ka minsan hentew ne ware ugpei te Panisingan te Manama, kene ne ki Kristu. 10 Piru ke duen e si Kristu te kaniyu, minsan egpatey ka lawa niyu tenged te sale, egkeuyag ded ka panisingan niyu tenged su in-isip kew ne matareng te Manama. 11 [xr]Ka Manama ka mig-uyag ki Hisus. Ne emun ke duen e te kaniyu ka Panisingan te Manama, eg-uyahen din degma ka lawa niyu ne egpatey pinaahi te Panisingan din due te kaniyu.

9 But you(pl), (you) do not comply with the desires of your(pl) sinful bodies, but rather, what you(pl) comply with is the Spirit of God if he is there in you(pl). But whoever isn't inhabited by the Spirit of God, (he) is not Kristu's. 10 But if Kristu is in you(pl), even_though your(pl) body dies as a result of sin, your(pl) spirit will_live because you(pl) are_considered righteous by God. 11 [xr]God is the (one who) raised_ Hisus _to_life. Now if the Spirit of God is in you(pl), he will_ also _raise_to_life your(pl) bodies that die by_means of his Spirit in you(pl).

12 Purisu me suled, due keilangan ne egtumanen ta iya, piru kene ne sika se igkeupii te lawa ta ne makasesale. 13 Su emun ke egparuma-ruma kew te igkeupii te lawa niyu ne makasesale, egpatey kew iya. Piru ke egpegnelen niyu ka hinimuwan ne igkeupii te lawa niyu pinaahi te bulig te Panisingan te Manama, due umul niyu ne ware egtamanan. 14 Su ka langun ne impanulu te Panisingan te Manama, me anak sikandan te Manama. 15 [xr][xr]Su ware kew behayi te Panisingan te Manama eyew eg-uripenen wey egliyasen, ke kene, eyew egkeyimu ne me anak te Manama. Sika ka egpuunan ne egpakarawit kid e kandin te “Amey”. 16 Ka Panisingan te Manama duma te panisingan ta ka egpamalehet ne me anak ki iya te Manama. 17 Ne puun su me anak kid te Manama, egpakarawat ki te panalangin duma ki Kristu. Su emun ke eg-antus ki iling ki Kristu, egpakasawit ki degma te katelesan din.

12 Therefore brothers, there_is something that we(incl) indeed need to fulfill, but (it is) not those desires of our(incl) sinful bodies. 13 For if you(pl) comply with the desires of your(pl) sinful bodies, you(pl) will_ really _die. But if you(pl) prevent the deeds that your(pl) bodies desire by_means of the help of the Spirit of God, you(pl) will_have life without end. 14 For all who are taught by the Spirit of God, they are children of God. 15 [xr][xr]For you(pl) were not given the Spirit of God in_order to be enslaved and fearful, but rather, in_order to become the children of God. That is the source/reason that we(incl) call him “Father”. 16 The Spirit of God along_with our(incl) spirit confirms that we(incl) are indeed the children of God. 17 And since we(incl) (are) the children of God, we(incl) will_receive a blessing along_with Kristu. For if we(incl) suffer like Kristu, we(incl) will_ also _participate in his splendor.

Ka egginguma ne katelesan

The splendor that will_arrive

18 Ke egsumsumanen ku ka me peg-antus ta kuntee, ware de nakaarew-arew te katelesan ne igpakita kanta keureme. 19 Su minsan ka langun ne inggimu te Manama, kenad egpekegteil ka egtetahad ne igpakite e te Manama ka me anak din. 20 [xr]Minsan kene egkeupian ka langun ne inggimu te Manama piru indilus din seini langun. Ne minsan iling due, duen ded egkapallateng 21 su egginguma ka timpu ne igpaawe din ded puun te pegkeuripen te kamatayen[fn] ka langun ne inggimu rin eyew egpakasawit ded te mateles ne kaligwangan te me anak te Manama. 22 Nakanengneng ki ne ligkat dengan taman kuntee, migdeg-uy te kasakit ka langun ne inggimu te Manama iling te malitan ne egbaletikan. 23 [xr]Ne kene ne sikandan de, su minsan sikanta se naleneban te Panisingan te Manama ne iyan ka an-anayan ne dasag kanta, migdeg-uy ki degma taheed te egtetahad ne eglekaten din e ka me lawa ta ne iyan palinneu ne eg-an-anaken kid te Manama. 24 Su sika ka impallateng ta puun te naluwas kid. Piru kenad egkapallateng ka duen e. Su nekey naan pad ka egpallatengen ke duen e? 25 Piru emun ke egpallateng ki te ware pad due, kene ki egkapelaan ne egtetahad.

18 When I think about our(incl) suffering now, (it is) just not comparable to the splendor that will_be_revealed to us(incl) in_the_future. 19 For even all that God made, (it) can no_longer remain_still while waiting for God to reveal his children. 20 [xr]Although all that God made did not desire (it) yet he cursed it all. And even_though (it is) like that, there_is yet hope 21 for the time will_arrive when he will set_free all that he made from the slavery of death[fn] so_that it can_participate in the beautiful freedom of the children of God. 22 We(incl) know that from before until now, all that God made has been_groaning in pain like a woman having labor_pains. 23 [xr]And not only them, for even we(incl) the ones_entered by the Spirit of God who is the first gift to us(incl), we(incl) also groan while waiting for his redeeming of our(incl) bodies which a sign that we(incl) are adopted by God. 24 For that is what_ we(incl) _hoped_for from when we(incl) were_saved. But what already exists is no_longer hoped_for. For what is still hoped_for if it already exists? 25 But if we(incl) hope for what does not yet exist, we(incl) will_ not _tire in waiting.

26 Iling naan ded due, egbulihan ki degma te Panisingan te Manama te kahuye ta. Kene ki egkateu ke egmenuwen te eg-ampu te eleg ne paahi, piru ka Panisingan te Manama ka eg-uney-uney egpangananey te Manama para kanta, duma te pegdeg-uy ne kenad igkalalag. 27 Ka Manama ne nakanengneng te suman-suman te me etew, nakanengneng degma te suman-suman te Panisingan din, su migpangananey sikandin sumale te pegbuut te Manama para te keet-etawan din.

26 Just like that, we(incl) are also helped by the Spirit of God in our(incl) weakness. We(incl) are_ not _skillful in how to pray in the right way, but the Spirit of God himself calls_for_help to God for us(incl), along_with groaning that can no_longer be spoken. 27 The God who knows the minds of people, (he) also knows the mind of his Spirit, for he calls_for_help according to the will of God for his people.

28 Nakanengneng ki ne ka langun ne egkeyitabu, eggimuwen sika ne meupiya te Manama para te seeye se miggeyinawa kandin ne in-alam din sumale te igkeupii rin. 29 Su seeye se tapey rin e alama, tapey rin e sikandan itahahe ne egpekeiling te Anak din eyew egkeyimu sikandin ne kinakakayan te langun ne tagtahasuled. 30 Ne seeye se tapey rin e itahahe, in-alam din degma, wey seeye se in-alam din, in-isip din ne matareng. Ne seeye se in-isip din ne matareng, impasawit din te katelesan te Anak din.

28 We(incl) know that everything that happens, it will_be_made good by God for those who love him whom he chose according to his desire. 29 For those he formerly chose, he formerly prepared for them to be_like his Child so_that he will_become the oldest_of_many of all the siblings. 30 And those whom he formerly prepared, he also chose, and those whom he chose, he considered righteous. And those whom he considered righteous, he allowed_to_participate in the splendor of his Child.

Ka geyinawa te Manama due ki Kristu Hisus

The love of God in Kristu Hisus

31 Na, nekey naan e ka igkalalag ta meyitenged kayi? Emun ke eglapig kanta ka Manama, hentew naa ka egpakatalu[fn] kanta? 32 Ware sikandin nannuhun te Anak din wey nasi din ibehey sikandin para kanta langun. Egkaayun naa degma ne kene ki nikandin egbehayan te langun ne ingkeilangan ta? 33 Hentew naa ka eleg ne egsumbung te me etew ne in-alam te Manama? Ware, su ka Manama ka mig-isip ne matareng e sikandan. 34 Ne hentew naa ka egpakakahi ne eleg ki ne eglegparan? Si Kristu Hisus naa ne migpatey piru neuyag ded wey diyad man-e te igkakawanan[fn] te Manama? Sikandin man-e ka egpangananey te Manama para kanta. 35 Nekey naa ka egpakapariyu kanta puun te geyinawa ni Kristu? Ka kalasayan naa wey ke keyirapan, wey ke pegbayad-bayad naa? Ka gutas naa wey ke ware kukumbaleen, ka pegsahap naa wey ke kamatayen? 36 [xr]Su sumale te Kasulatan,

31 Now_then, what will we(incl) say about this? If God favors us(incl), who is able_to_defeat[fn] us(incl)? 32 He was not possessive/protective of his Child and instead he gave him for us(incl) all. Is it possible that he will not also give us(incl) everything that we(incl) need? 33 Who is fit to accuse the people whom God chose? No (one), for God is the (one who) has considered them righteous. 34 And who will can say that we(incl) are correct/fit to be_punished? Is it Kristu Hisus who died but came_alive and is also there at the right_side[fn] of God? He is also the one_who_calls_ to God _for_help for us(incl). 35 What is able_to_distance us(incl) from the love of Kristu? Are troubles or difficulties, or persecution? Is hunger or no clothes_to_wear, danger or death? 36 [xr]For according to the Writings,

“Tenged keykew, duen key layun te tangkaan te kamatayen,

“Because of you(sg), we(excl) are always in the presence of death,

wey nekeiling key te me karniru ne eggilangen.”

and we(excl) are_like sheep who will_be_slaughtered.”

37 Piru minsan pad due langun, ware egpakatalu kanta su egpanalu ki iya pinaahi kandin ne miggeyinawa kanta! 38 Su nakamemalehet a ne minsan ka kamatayen wey ka umul, ka me panalihan wey ka me busew wey ka me due geem, wey ka minsan nekey ne kayid e wey ka egginguma pad, kene egpakapariyu kanta puun te geyinawa rin. 39 Minsan ka diye te ampew wey diye te diralem, wey ka langun ne kayi te kalibutan, kene iya egpakapariyu kanta puun te geyinawa te Manama ne impabaye din ki Kristu Hisus ne Magbebaye ta.

37 But even_though there_is all (of that), nothing is able_to_defeat us(incl) for we(incl) are indeed victorious by_means of him who loved us(incl)! 38 For I am certain that even death and life, angels and evil_spirits and those with power, and whatever is here now or will yet arrive, (they) are_ not _able_to_distance us(incl) from his love. 39 Even (what is) above or (what is) below, or everything here in the world, (they) are indeed not able_to_distance us(incl) from the love of God that he sends_by_way_of (LIT causes_to_go_through) Kristu Hisus our(incl) Lord.

Ka katenged te Manama te peg-alam

The authority of God for choosing

91 Malehet ka iglalag ku kaniyu wey kena a eg-uubat su nasabeka ad ki Kristu. Ka kunsinsya ku ne impanulu te Panisingan te Manama migpamalehet degma 2 ne amana ne mabehat ka diralem ku wey layun ne masakit ka pusung ku. 3 Eg-awesen ku pad ne iyan a egkarilus wey egpakasuwey ki Kristu para te keupianan te me suled ku ne me Hudiyu. 4 [xr]Sikandan ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, wey in-anak-anak te Manama. Impakita rin kandan ka katelesan din, wey imbehey rin kandan ka kasabutan wey Balaud din. Impanengneng din kandan ka malehet ne pegsimba wey migsaaran te meupiya. 5 Me mabantug ne etew ka me kabuybuyahan dan. Ne minsan ka Kristu,[fn] kabuhalan dan sikandin sumale te pegkeetew rin, wey Manama sikandin te langun. Egdayanen sikandin te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya.

91 What I say to you(pl) is true and I am not lying for I am one with Kristu. My conscience which is taught by the Spirit of God also confirms 2 that I am very sorrowful (LIT my insides are very heavy) and my heart is constantly in pain. 3 I wish to be the one cursed and separated from Kristu for the sake (LIT goodness) of my Hudiyu brothers. 4 [xr]They (are) the descendants of Israil, and adopted_children of God. He revealed his splendor to them, and he gave them the agreement and his Law. He made_known to them true worship and promised good_things. 5 Their elders were great people. And even the Kristu,[fn] he is their descendant according to his personhood, and he is God of all. He will_be_praised without end. True indeed.
