6 Piru minsan ke iling due, ware migpasabut ne ware natuman ka saad te Manama diye te Hudiyu, su kene ne langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil keet-etawan te Manama. 7 [xr]Kene degma langun ne anak ni Abraham ne kabuhalan din, su migkahiyan te Manama si Abraham, “Ka kabuhalan de ni Isaak ka eg-isipen ku ne kabuhalan nu.” 8 Ka igpasabut kayi ne kene ne me anak te Manama ka langun ne me anak ni Abraham, ke kene, seeye de se neetew tenged te insaad te Manama. 9 [xr]Su seini ka saad te Manama, “Te iling ded kayi ne timpu te seup ne leg-un, eglibed a kayi wey duen e anak ni Sara ne lukes.”

6 But even it is like that, it doesn't mean that the promise of God to the Hudiyu was not fulfilled, for not all of the descendants of Israil are people of God. 7 [xr]Also not all of his descendants are children of Abraham, for God said to Abraham, “I will_ only _consider the descendants of Isaak as your(sg) descendants.” 8 The meaning here is that not all the children of Abraham are children of God, but rather, only those born as a result of what God promised. 9 [xr]For this was the promise of God, “About this time next year, I will_return here and Sara will already have a male child.”

10 Ne kene ne sikan de, su te timpu ne migsesepingan pad si Ribika te anak dan ki Isaak ne kaapuan ta, 11-12 [xr]migkahiyan te Manama si Ribika, “Egpamakayen te kakey ka hari.” Ne minsan ware pad miglesut ka me bate wey ware pad nanengnengi ke mareet naa wey ke meupiya ka hinimuwan dan, piru impanengneng e te Manama ke hentew ka in-alam din. Su tapey e planuwa te Manama ke hentew ka eg-alamen din, wey kene ne tenged te hinimuwan ta. 13 [xr]Sikan naa ka miggenendue ka Kasulatan, “Miggeyinawaan ku si Hakub, piru migdumutan ku si Isaw.”

10 And not only that, for at the time that Rebecca was pregnant_with_the_twins of Isaak our(incl) ancestor, 11-12 [xr]God said to Rebecca, “The younger_sibling will_be_served by the older_sibling.” And although the children had_ not yet _been_born and it was not yet known whether their deeds were evil or good, yet God made_known whom he had chosen. For God plans in advance whom he will_choose, and it is not the result of our(incl) deeds. 13 [xr]And so the Writings go_like_this, “I loved Hakub, but I hated Isaw.”

14 Na, egpakakahi ki naa te kene ne matareng ka inggimu te Manama? Kene! 15 [xr]Su migkahiyan din si Muwisis, “Igkeyid-u ku seeye se igkeyid-u ku wey igkalulunu ku seeye se igkalulunu ku.” 16 Purisu ka peg-alam te Manama kene ne tenged te pegbuut te etew wey te pegpakannekal din, ke kene, tenged te hid-u rin. 17 [xr]Su nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne migkahiyan te Manama ka Hari te Ihiptu, “Inggimu ku sikeykew ne Hari eyew igpakapakita ku ka geem ku pinaahi te eggimuwen ku keykew, su eyew egmabantug ka ngaran ku diye te langun ne inged te kalibutan.” 18 Purisu iyan de igkeyid-u te Manama ka igkeupii rin ne igkeyid-u wey egpakehalen din ka ulu te igkeupii rin ne egpakehalen.

14 Now_then, are we(incl) able_to_say that what God has done is not righteous? No! 15 [xr]For he said to Muwisis, “I will_have mercy on those whom I have mercy and I will_feel_compassion for those whom I feel_compassion.” 16 Therefore God's choosing is not the result of the will of a person or his striving, but rather, a result of his mercy. 17 [xr]For it is written in the Writings that God said to the king of Ihiptu, “I made you(sg) a king so_that I can_reveal my power by_means of what_ I _will_do to you(sg), so_that my name will_become famous/honored in all the places of the world.” 18 Therefore the one God will_show_mercy_to is just whom he desires to show_mercy_to and he will_harden the head (of the one) he desires to harden.

Ka langet wey hid-u te Manama

The anger and mercy of God

19 Ne kema ke egkahiyan a nikaniyu, “Ke iling ma rue, mania te egsenditan ded te Manama ka etew ne impakehal rin se ulu? Duen naa iya mule etew ne egpakapanalliya te pegbuut te Manama?” 20 [xr]Piru etew ke re, wey nekey ka katenged nu ne egpakig-apul te Manama? Egpakasagsahukul naa ka inggimu re te miggimu kandin, “Mania te in-iling a nikeykew kayi te eggimu?” 21 Ware bes katenged te talaggimu te kuren ke kene din egpeg-ilingen te eggimu puun te tane ka daruwa ne kuren? Ware naa katenged din ne eggimuwen ne amana ne mateles ka sabeka wey eleg-eleg de ka dangeb?

19 Now perhaps you(pl) will_say to me, “If it's like that, why does God blame the person whose head he hardens? Is there really a person who is able to escape the will of God?” 20 [xr]But you(sg) are only a person, and what is your(sg) right to argue with God? Is the one_made able_to_complain to the one_who_made him, “Why did you(sg) make me like this?” 21 Does the maker of pots have_no [emphasis] right to make from soil two pots that (are) not the same? Does he have_no right to make one (of them) very beautiful and the other just OK?

22 Iling due ka inggimu te Manama. Igkeupii rin ne igpakita ka langet wey igpeila ka geem din. Piru nenaneyi sikandin egkeupul wey kene din egsalutan te eglegpad ka me etew ne natahahe e ne egdereetan, 23 eyew igpakapanengneng din degma te ingkeyid-u rin ka kein-inuwan ne keupiya rin, kayi te kanta te in-alam din ne egbehayan te sika ne keupiya. 24 Su sikanta ka keet-etawan ne in-alam din, wey kene ne me Hudiyu re su minsan degma ka kene ne me Hudiyu. 25 [xr]Su nasulat ni prupita Husiya ne migkahi ka Manama,

22 What God did is like that. He desired to reveal his anger and make_known his power. But he is very_slow to get_impatient and does not immediately punish the people whom he is angry_with whom are prepared for destruction, 23 in_order for him to also make_known his amazing goodness to the ones_ he _pities, to us(incl) whom he has chosen to be given that goodness. 24 For we(incl) (are) the people whom he chose, and not the Hudiyu only for even the non Hudiyu. 25 [xr]For it is written by prophet Hosea that God said,

“Seeye se kene ne keet-etawan ku,

“Those who are not my people,

egngaranan kud te keet-etawan ku,

I will_call/name my people,

wey seeye se ware ku geyinawei ne me etew,

and those people whom I don't love,

eggeyinawaan kud e.

I will_love.

26 [xr]Ne diye te inged ke hendei kahii sikandan,

26 [xr]And in the place where it is said to them,

‘Kene ku sikaniyu ne keet-etawan,’

‘You(pl) are not my people,’

diye degma sikandan egngarani te me anak te manekal ne Manama.”

there also they will_be_called/named the children of the living (LIT strong) God.”

27 [xr]Ne migtagne degma si prupita Isayas meyitenged te matig-Israil, “Minsan iling kasulug te lelanek diye te ilis te dahat ka kabuhalan ni Israil, piru deisek de ka egkaluwas.” 28 Su igpaneem-neem iya te Magbebaye ne Manama kayi te kalibutan ka peglegpad din ne mapahetpet wey kene eglamlamuwan. 29 [xr]Ne iling pad man-e kayi ka ingkahi ni Isayas, “Emun ke ware pa miggaat ka Maresen ne Magbebaye ne Manama te pila-pila ne kabuhalan ta te me Hudiyu, nahule kid perem iling te natamanan te matig-Suduma wey matig-Gumura.”

27 [xr]And prophet Isayas also prophesied concerning the (ones) from_Israil, “Even_though the descendants of Israil are as many as the grains_of_sand at the edge of the sea, yet only a few will_be_saved.” 28 For the Lord God will_cause_ his punishment _to_be_experienced (LIT tasted) rigorously here on the world and not lazily. 29 [xr]And also like this was what Isayas said, “If the Powerful Lord God had_ not _looked_after a few of our(incl) Hudiyu descendants, we(incl) would have_been_exterminated like the ending of the (ones) from_Sodom and the ones_from Gomorrah.”

Ka peggubabe te kabuhalan ni Israil

The disobedience of the descendants of Israil

30 Na, seini re ka igkalalag ta meyitenged kayi. Ka kene ne me Hudiyu ne ware migpakannekal ne egkeyimu ne matareng, nasi neyimu ne matareng pinaahi te pegpalintutuu. 31 Piru ka kabuhalan ni Israil ne migpakannekal ne egkeyimu ne matareng pinaahi te pegtuman te Balaud, nasi natalangaan. 32 Mania te neiling due? Tenged su migpakannekal sikandan kene ne pinaahi te pegpalintutuu, ke kene, pinaahi te meupiya ne hinimuwan. Nakasipe sikandan te egpakaparugsu ne batu ne iyan si Kristu. 33 [xr]Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan,

30 Now_then, just this is what we(incl) will_say about it. The non Hudiyu who did not strive to become righteous, instead became righteous by_means of faith. 31 But the descendants of Israil who strove to become righteous by_means of obeying the Law, instead were distracted_and_failed. 32 Why is (it) like that? Because they strove not by_means of faith, but rather, by_means of good works. They stumbled (LIT happened_to_kick) on the stone that causes_to_fall_down which is Kristu. 33 [xr]For according to what is written in the Writings,

“Pitew kew, igtahu ku diye te Hirusalim[fn] ka batu eyew egpakasipe ka me etew,

“Look(pl), I placed in Hirusalim[fn] a rock in_order to cause_ people _to_stumble (LIT happen_to_kick),

wey egpakaparugsu kandan.

and to cause_ them _to_fall_down.

Piru ka egpalintutuu wey egsalig kandin kene iya egkeyilawan.”

But the ones_who_believe and trust him will_ indeed not _be_shamed.”

101 Me suled, igkalelehet kud iya perem ne egkaluwas ka duma ku ne me Hudiyu, wey in-ampu ku sika diye te Manama. 2 Su egpakamemalehet a ne mapahetpet ka pegpamakey ran te Manama piru nekeisu te eleg ne pegpamakey. 3 Su ware sikandan nakanengneng te pegkamatareng ne puun de te Manama, wey nasi sikandan migparahas-dahas te kandan ne paahi eyew egkamatareng wey ware sikandan nakatuman te paahi te Manama. 4 Su duen de nataman ki Kristu ka Balaud eyew ka tagse etew ne due pegpalintutuu eg-isipen ne matareng te Manama.

101 Brothers/friends, I indeed intensely_desire that my fellow Hudiyu be_saved, and I pray that to God. 2 For I can_confirm that their serving God is rigorous but (it) deviated from correct serving. 3 For they did not know the righteousness which is just from God, but instead they sought their (own) way to become_righteous and they did not fulfill/comply_with the way of God. 4 For the Law ended in Kristu so_that each person who has faith is considered righteous by God.

Ka kaluwasan para te langun ne etew

Salvation is for all people

5 [xr]Migsusulat si Muwisis meyitenged te pegkamatareng pinaahi te pegtuman te Balaud, “Ka etew ne mig-ikul te Balaud egkeuyag tenged te Balaud.” 6 [xr]Piru nasulat te Kasulatan ka meyitenged te pegkamatareng pinaahi te pegpalintutuu, “Kene ka inse diye te suman-suman nu, ‘Hentew-a ka eggendiye te langit?’ ” (eyew egpepamaneuhen si Kristu). 7 “Wey ke, ‘Hentew-a ka egpamaneug diye te ugpaan te gimukud?’ ” (eyew eg-uyahen si Kristu). 8 Su sumale te Kasulatan, “Marani keykew ka lalag te Manama. Nakapamule e seini due te pusung nu wey igkalalag nud e.” Sika ne lalag meyitenged te pegpalintutuu ne inwali ney. 9 Su emun ke eg-angkenen nu ne Magbebaye si Hisus wey egpalintutuu ka te mapahetpet ne in-uyag sikandin te Manama, egkaluwas ka. 10 Su eg-isipen ne matareng ka etew ne mapahetpet ne egpalintutuu, wey egkaluwas sikandin puun te peg-angken din te impalintutuuwan din. 11 [xr]Su migkahi ka Kasulatan, “Ka minsan hentew ne egpalintutuu wey egsalig kandin, kene iya egkeyilawan.” 12 Su ware kaleinan te me Hudiyu wey te kene ne me Hudiyu. Sabsabeka re iya ka Magbebaye te langun ne etew wey egtumpisan din ka langun ne egpangananey kandin. 13 [xr]Su sumale te Kasulatan, “Ka langun ne egpangananey te Magbebaye, egkaluwas.”

5 [xr]Muwisis wrote concerning righteousness by_means of fulfilling the Law, “The person who follows the Law will_live as a result of the Law.” 6 [xr]But it is written in the Scriptures concerning righteousness by_means of faith, “Don't(sg) ask in your(sg) thinking, ‘Who will_go to heaven?’ ” (so_that Kristu would_be_caused_to_descend). 7 “Or if, ‘Who will_descend to the living_place of the souls?’ ” (so_that Kristu would_be_raised_to_life). 8 For according to the Writings, “The word of God is near to you(sg). It has been_planted in your(sg) heart and you(sg) will_speak (it).” That is the word concerning faith that we(excl) preach. 9 For if you(sg) acknowledge that Hisus is Lord and you(sg) rigorously believe that God raised_ him _to_life, you(sg) will_be_saved. 10 For the person who rigorously believes is considered righteous, and he will_be_saved by his acknowlegment of whom he believes_in. 11 [xr]For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes and trusts him, (he) will_ indeed not _be_shamed.” 12 For there_is_no difference_between the Hudiyu and the non Hudiyu. The Lord of all people is indeed only one and he is generous to all who call_out_ to him _for_help. 13 [xr]For according to the Writings, “All who call_out_ to the Lord _for_help, (they) will_be_saved.”

14 Piru egmenuwen naa te me etew te egpangananey kandin te ware ma sikandan migpalintutuu wey migsalig kandin? Ne egmenuwen dan naa te egpalintutuu te ware dan ma nakarineg te guhuren meyitenged kandin? Ne egmenuwen dan naa te egpakarineg ke ware egwali diye te kandan? 15 [xr]Ne egmenuwen naa te etew te egwali ke ware egsuhu kandan? Piru duen e insuhu ne egwali su nasulat te Kasulatan, “Amana ne tetelesi ka paa te seeye se eg-uyan te Meupiya ne Panugtulen!” 16 [xr]Piru kene ne langun ne etew ne migdawat te Meupiya ne Panugtulen. Su migkahi si prupita Isayas, “Magbebaye ne Manama, hentew-a ka migpalintutuu te inwali ney?” 17 Sikan naa, egpakapalintutuu ka me etew emun egpakarineg te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Kristu.

14 But how will people call_out_ to him _for_help if they have_ not _believed or trusted in him? And how will_ they _believe if they have_ not _been_able_to_hear the story about him? And how will_ they _be_able_to_hear if no one preaches to them? 15 [xr]And how will people preach if no one commands/sends them? But there are already those_who_were_commanded/sent to preach for it is written in the Writings, “The feet of those who bring the Good Report are very beautiful!” 16 [xr]But not all people accepted the Good Report. For prophet Isayas said, “Lord God, who believed what we(excl) preached?” 17 And so, people are able_to_believe if (they) can hear the Good Report about Kristu.

18 [xr]Piru eg-insa a: Ware naa nakarineg ka me Hudiyu te guhuren? Nakarineg ded sikandan, su sumale te Kasulatan,

18 [xr]But I ask: Did the Hudiyu not hear the report? They did hear, for according to the Writings,

“Nanengku-sengku ka laheng dan te intiru ne kalibutan;

“Their voice was_heard_throughout the entire world;

wey nangabbas-abbas ka me lalag dan diye te katamanan te inged.”

and their words spread everywhere (LIT pierced_through to the last place).”

19 [xr]Ne eg-abey ad man-e eg-inse: Ware naa sikandan nakasabut? Nakasabut dan ded, su nasulat ni Muwisis ne migkahi ka Manama,

19 [xr]And I ask again: Did they not understand? They did understand, for Muwisis wrote that God said,

“Egpeimmeen ku sikaniyu

“I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_envy

te kene ne me Hudiyu.[fn]

the non Hudiyu.[fn]

Egpeyibeluen ku sikaniyu

I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_become_angry

pinaahi te me etew ne egkengeungel.”

by_means of people who are foolish.”

20 [xr]Ne ware degma pegkaaldek ni Isayas te migkahi,

20 [xr]And Isayas also had no fear when (he) said,

“Natulituan a te seeye se ware migpamitew keddi.

“I was discovered by those who did not search for me.

Migpakita a te seeye se migbalahad keddiey.”

I revealed (myself) to those who ignored/neglected me.”

21 [xr]Piru seini ka ingkahi rin meyitenged te me Hudiyu, “Aldew-aldew a ka egpangumew te me etew ne masinupaken wey makehal se me ulu.”

21 [xr]But this is what he said concerning the Hudiyu, “Day_by_day I am calling a people who are rebellious and (who have) hard heads.”

Ka hid-u te Manama para te me Hudiyu

The mercy of God for the Hudiyu

111 [xr]Sikan naa eg-insa a, “Imbalahad naa te Manama ka keet-etawan din ne me Hudiyu?” Ware iya! Su minsan sikeddi, Hudiyu a degma ne kabuhalan ni Abraham, wey nabuhal puun te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 2 Ware balahara te Manama ka keet-etawan din ne tapey rin e alama. Sumsumana niyu ka ingkahi te Kasulatan meyitenged ki Ilyas ne migpangananey te Manama. Migsalew-salew sikandin te me Hudiyu 3 [xr]ne migkahi, “Magbebaye ne Manama, impangimatayan dan ka me prupita nu wey impangguhus dan ka me altar nu. Sikeddi naan de ka nasame wey eggimatayan a perem nikandan.” 4 [xr]Piru nekey ka intabak te Manama kandin? “Duen pad inlein ku ne pitu ne libu (7,000) ne me etew ne ware migsimba te diyus-diyus ne si Baal.” 5 Ne iling naan ded degma due kuntee, duen pad pila-pila ne me Hudiyu ne in-alam te Manama tenged te keupiya wey keyid-u rin. 6 Piru ke in-alam din sikandan tenged te keupiya wey keyid-u rin, kenad ne tenged te hinimuwan dan ne in-alam sikandan. Su emun ke in-alam din sikandan tenged te hinimuwan dan, kene tad egkakahi ne keupiya wey keyid-u pad seini.

111 [xr]And so I ask, “Did God ignore/neglect his people the Hudiyus?” Indeed not! For even me, I am also a Hudiyu (NOTE not the team's normal keyterm for Israilita but avoids redundancy with what follows) and descendant of Abraham, and descended from the descendants of Binhamin. 2 God did not ignore/neglect his people whom he had chosen beforehand. Think_about(pl) what the Writings say concerning Ilyas who called_out_for_help to God. He complained about the Hudiyu 3 [xr]and said, “Lord God, they have killed your(sg) prophets and they demolished your(sg) altars. Only I am left and they want to kill me.” 4 [xr]But what did God answer him? “There are yet seven thousand (7,000) people whom I have set_aside who have_ not _worshiped the idol of Baal.” 5 And just like that also today, there are yet a few Hudiyu chosen by God because of his goodness and mercy. 6 But if he chose them because of his goodness and mercy, (it is) no_longer because of their works that they were_chosen. For if he chose them because of their works, we(incl) could no_longer say that this was still goodness and mercy.

7 Na, nekey naan e? Ware nakaangken ka kasuluhan te me Hudiyu te impamitew ran, piru naangken seini te seeye se in-alam te Manama. Ka duma impakehal te Manama ka me ulu ran. 8 [xr]Sumale te ingkahi te Kasulatan,

7 Now_then, what (now)? The many Hudiyu were_ not _able_to_obtain what they sought, but this was obtained by those ones chosen by God. The others had their heads hardened by God. 8 [xr]According to what is said in the Writings,

“Inggimu sikandan te Manama ne egpekeiling te mulug ne etew,

“God made them like a deep_sleeper person,

due me mata ran piru kene sikandan egpakakita,

they have eyes but they are_ not _able_to_see,

due me talinga ran piru kene sikandan egpakarineg

they have ears but they are_ not _able_to_hear

taman kuntee.”

until now.”

9 [xr]Ne migkahi si Dabid meyitenged kandan,

9 [xr]And Dabid said concerning them,

“Egkengarakep perem sikandan wey egkengasapenan ka egliblibulung ne eggale-gale,

“May they be captured and caught_in_the_act in their happy gatherings,

iling te mahintalunan ne migsahad te baled wey kenad egpakaawe!10 Egkengabutud perem sikandan eyew kenad egpakakita

like a wild_animal that is trapped by a snare and unable to escape!10 May they become_blind so_that (they) are no_longer able_to_see

wey egkabekut perem sikandan te ware egtamanan.”

and may they bend_(their)_backs without end.”

11 Sikan naa ka eg-insa a, ke nakasipe wey nakarugsu ka me Hudiyu, kene naan e sikandan egpekeenew? Kene ne iling due! Su pinaahi te pegsupak dan, naluwas ka kene ne me Hudiyu eyew igkasekel ran sikandan. 12 Ne emun ka pegsupak wey pegsahap te me Hudiyu egpakabehey te keupianan te langun ne kene ne me Hudiyu kayi te ampew te tane, wey naan pa iya ke masulug ded ka me Hudiyu ne egpalintutuu.

11 And so I ask, if the Hudiyu stumbled (LIT happened_to_kick_something) and fell_down, are they unable to rise? Not like that! For by_means of their disobedience, the non Hudiyu were_saved so_that they will_be_envied by them. 12 And if the disobedience and failure of the Hudiyus is able_to_give goodness to all the non Hudiyus, even_more yet indeed if many Hudiyu believe.

Ka kaluwasan te kene ne me Hudiyu

The salvation of the non Hudiyu

13 Kuntee egnangenan ku sikaniyu se kene ne me Hudiyu. Apustulis a eyew egwali diye te kaniyu, wey indakelan ku seini ne himu 14 eyew egkeimma ka duma ku ne me Hudiyu wey sika ka paahi ne egkaluwas ka duma kandan. 15 Su emun ke ka peg-inniyug te Manama te me Hudiyu iyan egpuunan ne nekeg-uli ded ka meupiya ne geyinawa rin te duma ne me etew kayi te ampew te tane, iyan naan pa iya ke egdawaten din ded sikandan. Su emun ke egdawaten din ded man-e sikandan, iyan egkeilingan te egpangkusan kayi ka pegkeuyag te minatey.

13 Now I am_speaking to you(pl) non Hudiyu. I (am) an apostle in_order to preach to you(pl), and I love/promote (LIT make_big) this work 14 so_that my fellow Hudiyu will_become_envious and that is the way that some of them will_be_saved. 15 For if God's turning_his_back on the Hudiyu is the source of reconciliation (LIT his good breath returned) to other people here on earth (LIT top of the ground), how much more indeed if he accepts them again. For if he accepts them again, the result of this is comparable to the resurrection of a corpse.

16 Panunggiling ke due paan ne inhalad ka baad diye te Manama, iling ded te nalagkes e degma te peghalad ka same te paan. Ne ka kayu degma, su emun ke ka dalid kandin te Manama, kandin naan ded man-e ka me sugpang. 17 Iyan panunggilingan te me Hudiyu ka pinamula ne ulibu ne impanempuhan te duma ne me sugpang. Ne sikaniyu se kene ne me Hudiyu, egpekeiling kew te me sugpang te leew ne ulibu ne impanugpat diye te lawa te pinamula ne ulibu, wey nekegsaamul kew e te kalambuan te malehet ne sugpang. 18 Piru kene niyu lemeti seeye se impanempug ne me sugpang, su tantanuri niyu ne kene ne sikaniyu ka mig-uyag te dalid, ke kene, ka dalid ka mig-uyag kaniyu.

16 For_example if there_is bread and part was_offered to God, (it is) like the rest of the bread was also included in the offering. And also a tree, for if its root is God's, the branches are also his. 17 An illustration of the Hudiyu is an olive plant with some branches chopped_off. And you(pl) non Hudiyu, you(pl) are compared to branches of a wild olive that were joined to the body of the olive plant, and you(pl) have in common the nutrients (LIT fatness) of the true branch(es). 18 But don't(sg) mock those branches that were chopped_off, for be(sg) aware that you(pl) (are) not the ones who supply_life to the root, but rather, the root supplies_life to you(pl).

19 Ne kema ke due egkahi, “Uya, piru impanempug seeye ne me sugpang eyew igpakasugpat key subal kandan.” 20 Malehet sika, impanempug sikandan su ware sikandan migpalintutuu piru nakasubal kew re su migpalintutuu kew. Sikan naa, kene kew paketul, ke kene, kaaldek kew. 21 Su emun ke ware ul-ulungi te Manama te egpanempug ka malehet ne me sugpang, kene din degma eg-ul-ulungan te egpanempug ka kene ne malehet ne me sugpang iling kaniyu te kene ne me Hudiyu. 22 Egkakita ta kayi ke kamenu karakel ka hid-u te Manama wey ka kabulut din degma. Mabulut sikandin te seeye se migsupak, piru sikaniyu, igkeyid-u kew nikandin ke egpabulus kew egsalig te keyid-u rin. Su emun ke kene, egpanempuhen kew degma. 23 Ne seeye se me Hudiyu ne kenad egpakehal-kehal su egsalig e te Manama, iglibed din ded sikandan igsugpat su egkeyimu sika te Manama. 24 Ne sikaniyu se egpekeiling te me sugpang te leew ne ulibu, emun ke ingkasugpat kew nikandin diye te pinamula ne ulibu, iyan din naan pa iya kene igpakasugpat ded ka malehet ne me sugpang kayi.

19 And perhaps someone will_say, “Yes, but those branches were chopped_off so_that we(excl) are able_to_be_joined in place of them.” 20 That is true, they were chopped_off because they did not obey/believe but you(pl) only replaced (them) because you(pl) obeyed/believed. And so, don't(pl) become_proud (LIT swell_up), but rather, be_afraid(pl). 21 For if God did not hesitate to chop_off the true branches, he will_ not _hesitate to also chop_off the not true branches like you(pl) non Hudiyus. 22 We(incl) see here how large is the compassion of God and also his fierceness. He is fierce to those who are disobedient, but you(pl), will_be_shown_mercy by him if you(pl) continue to trust in his mercy. For if not, you(pl) will_ also _be_chopped_off. 23 And those Hudiyu that are no_longer hardened because (they) trust God, he will_ just _rejoin them for God can do this. 24 And you(pl) who are compared to wild olive branches, if he can join you(pl) to the olive plant, how much more is he able_to_join the true branches to it.

Ka hid-u te Manama te langun ne etew

The compassion of God for all people

25 Me suled, egkeupian a ne egkanengnengan niyu ka nekeeles ne kamalehetan su eyew kene kew egpakapeggasal ne me matagseb kew e. Iyan ku igpanengneng kaniyu ne egkataman de ka kakehal te me ulu te Hudiyu te timpu ne egkatimpad e ka kasulug te kene ne me Hudiyu ne egpalintutuu. 26 [xr]Ne puun due, egkaluwas ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil. Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan,

25 Brothers/friends, I want you(pl) to understand the hidden truth so_that you(pl) will_ not _be_able_to_boast that you(pl) (are) wise. What I will_make_known to you(pl) is that the hardness of the heads of the Hudiyu will_end at the time that the number of non Hudiyu who believe/obey is complete. 26 [xr]And from that, all descendants of Israil will_be_saved. For according to what is written in the Writings,

“Diye egpuun te Hirusalim[fn] ka Manluluwas.

“The Savior is_come_from Hirusalim.[fn]

Eg-aween din ka mareet ne hinimuwan te kabuhalan ni Hakub.

He will_remove the wicked deeds of the descendants of Hakub.

27 [xr]Ne egkatuman iya ka kasabutan ku dengan kandan

27 [xr]And my former agreement with them will_ truly _be_fulfilled

ne eg-aween ku ka me sale dan.”

that I will_remove their sins.”

28 Meyitenged te peggubabe te me Hudiyu te Meupiya ne Panugtulen, neyimu sikandan ne kuntere te Manama ne iyan nakabulig kaniyu. Piru meyitenged te peg-alam kandan te Manama, indakelan din ded sikandan te geyinawa puun te saad din te kaap-apuan dan. 29 Su kene iya egkabalbalawan ka suman-suman te Manama meyitenged te dasag wey peg-alam din. 30 Sikaniyu se kene ne me Hudiyu, migsupak kew dengan te Manama, piru kuntee ingkeyid-u kew nikandin tenged te pegsupak te me Hudiyu. 31 Ne iling naan ded degma due, migsupak sikandan te Manama kuntee piru igkeyid-u red degma sikandan te Manama tenged te pegkeyid-u rin kaniyu. 32 Su nekeiling te imprisu te Manama ka langun ne etew te kandan ne pegkamasinupaken eyew igpakapapitew rin kandan ka keyid-u rin.

28 Concerning the Hudiyu disbelieving the Good News, they became enemies of God which was_able_to_help you(pl). But concerning God's choosing of them, he still greatly loved them because of his promise to their ancestor(s). 29 For the mind of God indeed does not change concerning (his) gift and his choosing. 30 You(pl) non Hudiyu, you(pl) formerly disobeyed God, but now he has been_merciful to you(pl) because of the disobedience of the Hudiyus. 31 And also just like that, they have disobeyed God now but they will_ also _be_shown_mercy by God as a result of his mercy to you(pl). 32 Because it's like God imprisoned all people in their disobedience so_that he could_show them his mercy.

Egsayeen ka Manama

God will_be_praised

33 [xr]Amana ne matubung ka Manama te keyid-u wey amana ne dakel ka katuenan din wey kaalam! Ware egpakatirew te me planu rin wey ware egpakasabut te me paahi rin! 34 [xr]Su nasulat te Kasulatan ne miggenendue,

33 [xr]God is very abundant in mercy and his skill and wisdom are very great! No one is able_to_measure/test his plans and no one is able_to_understand his ways! 34 [xr]For (it is) written in the Writings like_this,

“Hentew naa ka nakataha te suman-suman te Magbebaye ne Manama?

“Who is able_to_understand the thoughts of the Lord God?

Hentew naa ka egpakapanulu kandin te eleg ne eggimuwen?

Who is able_to_teach him the right thing_to_do?

35 [xr]Hentew naa ka nakadasag kandin te minsan nekey,

35 [xr]Who is able_to_gift him with anything,

ne keilangan ne egsulian din?”

that (it is) necessary that he repay_it?”

36 [xr]Su sikandin ka miggimu te langun wey egbuut kayi. Neyimu ka langun eyew egkareyrey sikandin. Egdayanen sikandin te ware egtamanan. Malehet iya.

36 [xr]For he is the (one who) made everything and rules_over it. Everything was_made in_order to praise him. He will_be_praised without end. True indeed.

Ka eleg ne pegpamakey te Manama

The correct serving of God

121 Sikan naa me suled, tenged te hid-u te Manama kanta, egbanasalan ku sikaniyu ne ibehey niyu ka lawa niyu diye te Manama isip halad ne manekal, matulus wey egpakapahale kandin. Sika ka eleg ne eggimuwen niyu eyew te pegsimba kandin. 2 Kene kew paruma-ruma te egbatasanen te me etew te kuntee ne timpu, ke kene, tuhuti niyu ne egkabalbalawan te Manama ka pegkeetew niyu pinaahi te peg-iyam din te suman-suman niyu. Ne puun due, egkanengnengan niyu ke nekey ka igkeupii rin ne iyan ka meupiya, egpakapahale wey ka ware seyyup.

121 And so brothers, because of the mercy of God for us(incl), I urge you(pl) that you(pl) give your(pl) bodies to God as_if a sacrifice that is living, holy and able_to_please him. That is the correct thing_ for you(pl) _to_do in_order to worship him. 2 Don't follow_along_with the customs of the people nowadays (LIT now/today time), but rather, permit(pl) God to change your(pl) self/personhood by_means of his making_new your(pl) thinking. And from that, you(pl) will_understand what he desires that is good, able_to_please and without error.

3 Su tenged te katenged ne imbehey keddiey te Manama, egkahiyan ku sikaniyu te kene niyu iparibabew ka suman-suman niyu meyitenged te pegkeetew niyu, ke kene, ipaayun-ayun niyu re ka suman-suman niyu sumale te pegpalintutuu ne imbehey kaniyu te Manama. 4 [xr]Su sabeka re ka lawa te etew piru masulug ka baad wey ware nenekeg-iling ka himu te tagse baad. 5 Ne iling ki red degma se migmalintutuu, su minsan masulug ki piru sabeka ki re ne lawa su nasabeka kid diye te ki Kristu, wey nenekegsugpat ki langun. 6 [xr]Imbehayan ki te Manama te nalein-lein ne katuenan tenged te keyid-u rin. Purisu ke imbehayan ka te katuenan te pegpangguhud te impanengneng te Manama diye te keykew, gamita nu sika sumale te pegpalintutuu nu. 7 Ne emun ke imbehayan ka te katuenan te pegtanggu, tanggu ka, wey ke imbehayan ka te katuenan te pegpanulu, panulu ka. 8 Emun ke imbehayan ka te katuenan te pegbagget te duma, sika iya himuwa nu, wey ke iyan nu katuenan ka pegbehey te egkaayu-ayu, behey ka ne ware lehed-lehed. Ne emun ke pegpangulu ka katuenan nu, pangulu ka ne maali-ali, wey ke iyan nu katuenan ka hiid-uwen te duma, parumeyi nu te kahale ka hid-u nu.

3 For because of the responsibility that was_given to me by God, I say to you(pl) to not exalt(pl) your(pl) thinking about your(pl) self/personhood, but rather, just adjust(pl) your(pl) thinking according to the faith that was_given to you(pl) by God. 4 [xr]For a person has only one body but many parts and the work of each part is not the same. 5 And we(incl) believers are also similar (to that), for although we(incl) are many yet we(incl) are just one body for we(incl) have become_one in Kristu, and we(incl) are all joined_to_each_other. 6 [xr]God has_given us(incl) various skills because of his mercy. Therefore if you(sg) are given the skill for storying what God has revealed to you(sg), use(sg) that according to your(sg) faith. 7 And if you(sg) are given the skill for caring_for_others, do(sg) that indeed, and if you(sg) are given the skill to teach, teach(sg). 8 If you(sg) are given the skill for encouraging others, do that indeed, or if your(sg) skill is giving to the destitute, give(sg) without stinginess. And if leadership is your(sg) skill, lead(sg) diligently, or if your(sg) skill is in having_mercy on others, be(sg) joyful in your(sg) mercy (LIT cause_ joy _to_accompany your(sg) mercy).

9 Keilangan ne malehet ka geyinawa niyu te duma. Dumuti niyu ke nekey ka mareet wey desdeseni niyu ka meupiya. 10 Paheyinaweey kew te tagse sabeka iling te pegpaheyinaweey te tagtahasuled, wey pegtagtahurey kew amana. 11 Kene kew papepehul, ke kene, pamakey kew ne mabagget-bagget diye te Magbebaye. 12 Kahale kew tenged te impallateng niyu puun te Manama, kene kew kapeleyi ne eg-antus te me keyirapan wey ampu kew layun. 13 Behayi niyu ka keilangan ne egbulihan ne keet-etawan te Manama, wey paal-alumameey kew.

9 (It is) necessary that your(pl) love for others is true. Hate(pl) what is evil and firmly_grasp(pl) the good_things. 10 Love_[reciprocally](pl) every one like the loving_one_another of siblings, and honor_one_another(pl) greatly. 11 Don't(pl) be lazy, but rather, serve the Lord with excitement. 12 Be(pl) happy as a result of what you(pl) hope from God, don't(pl) get_tired of suffering difficulties and always pray(pl). 13 Give(pl) what is needed to_help the people of God, and be hospitable_to_each_other(pl).

14 [xr]Ampu kew te Manama ne egpanalanginan din seeye se migbayad-bayad kaniyu, wey kene niyu sikandan dilusa. 15 Kahale kew duma te seeye se nenahale, wey lungku kew duma te seeye se nanlungku. 16 [xr]Peuy-uyuney kew te tagse sabeka. Kene kew paambug, ke kene, paal-alukuyey kew te kabaluan de ne me etew, wey kene kew suman-suman ne matagseb kew.

14 [xr]Pray(pl) to God that he will_bless those who persecute you(pl), and don't(pl) curse them. 15 Be(pl) happy with those who are happy, and mourn(pl) with those who mourn. 16 [xr]Live_agreeably_together(pl) with every one. Don't be proud, but rather, befriend(pl) just ordinary people, and don't(pl) think that you(pl) (are) wise.

17 Kene niyu sulii te mareet ka etew ne miggimu kaniyu te mareet, ke kene, sumsumana niyu ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen diye te tangkaan te langun ne etew. 18 Taman te egkeyimu niyu, gerami niyu ne egpekegtuleddu kew te langun ne etew. 19 [xr]Inggeyinawaan ku ne me suled, kene kew suli, ke kene, balahara niyud sika su iyan e mateu ne eglegpad kandan ka Manama. Su nasulat te Kasulatan ne migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Sikeddiey ka egsuli, sikeddi ka egbayad.” 20 [xr]Purisu ikula niyu ka ingkahi te Kasulatan, “Ke miggutasan ka kuntere nu, pakeena nu sikandin; ke nammaraan sikandin, peinuma nu. Su emun ke eggimuwen nu sika, egkeyilew e sikandin te mareet ne inggimu rin.” 21 Kene kew pareeg te mareet, ke kene, deeha niyu ka mareet pinaahi te meupiya ne himu.

17 Don't(pl) wickedly avenge a person who does evil to you(pl), but rather, consider(pl) what is the right thing_to_do in the presence of all people. 18 As far as you(pl) can do, attempt(pl) to get_along(pl) with all people. 19 [xr]My beloved brothers, don't(pl) take_revenge, but rather, just ignore(pl) it because the (one who) in_charge/responsible to punish them is God. For it is written in the Writings that the Lord God said, “I (am) the one to take_revenge, I (am) the one to repay.” 20 [xr]Therefore follow(pl) what is said in the Writings, “If your(sg) enemy is hungry, feed(sg) him; if he is thirsty, give_drink(sg) to him. For if you(sg) do that, he will_be_ashamed at the wicked_thing he did.” 21 Don't(pl) be defeated by evil, but rather, defeat(pl) evil by_means of good deed(s).

Ka pegparuma-ruma te me upisyal te gubirnu

Complying with officials of the government

131 Ka langun keilangan ne egparuma-ruma te upisyal te gubirnu su ware migpangatungdanan ne ware ituhut te Manama. Ne seeye se migpangatungdanan, intunde sikandan te Manama. 2 Purisu ka egsupak te upisyal te gubirnu, egsupak te intunde te Manama wey eglegparan ka eggimu kayi. 3 Su ka miggimu te meupiya, kene egkaaldek te seeye se migpangatungdanan, ke kene, ka miggimu re te mareet. Ne emun ke egkeupian kew ne kene egkaaldek te seeye se migpangatungdanan, keilangan ne meupiya ka eggimuwen niyu wey egdayanen kew pad iya nikandan. 4 Su suluhuanen sikandan te Manama eyew due keupianan niyu. Piru ke miggimu kew te mareet, eleg iya ne egkaaldek kew su imbehayan iya sikandan te katenged eyew te peglegpad. Suluhuanen sikandan te Manama eyew eg-uyan te legpad din diye te miggimu te mareet. 5 Purisu keilangan ne egparuma-ruma ki te migpangatungdanan, kene ne puun de su egpanalliya ki ne egkalegparan, ke kene, puun su nakanengneng ki ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen.

131 Everyone needs to comply with the officials of the government because there_is_no authority_figure that God has not permitted. And those authority_figures, they were appointed by God. 2 Therefore the one_who_disobeys an official of the government, disobeys the one_appointed by God and the one_who_does it will_be_punished. 3 For the one_doing good, (he) is not afraid of those authority_figures, but rather, just the one_who_did evil. And if you(pl) don't want to be_afraid of those authority_figures, what you(pl) do needs to be good and you(pl) will_ indeed _be_praised by them. 4 For they are servants of God so_that you(pl) will_have peace. But if you(pl) do evil, (it is) indeed correct that you(pl) will_be_afraid for they were indeed given the responsibility/right for punishing. They are servants of God in_order to bring his punishment to the one_who_does evil. 5 Therefore (it is) necessary that we(incl) comply with the authority_figures, not only because we(incl) are avoiding being_punished, but rather, because we(incl) know what is the right_thing to do.

6 [xr]Sika ka egpuunan ne egbayad ki degma te me buhis, su me suluhuanen te Manama seeye se migpangatungdanan ne migpakannekal te trabahu ran. 7 Sikan naa ka egbayaran ta ka keilangan ne egbayaran wey ka langun ne buhis, wey eg-ayad-ayad egtahud te langun ne migpangatungdanan.

6 [xr]That is the source/reason that we(incl) also pay taxes, for those authority_figures are servants of God who strive to do their jobs. 7 And so we(incl) pay what needs to be paid and all taxes, and are careful to honor all authority_figures.

Ka katungdanan te tagse sabeka

The responsibility of each one

8 Kene ta egmananayen te egbayad ke due utang ta diye te duma, piru egtantanuran ta layun ka utang ta ne egpaheyinaweey te tagse sabeka. Su ka miggeyinawa te duma nakatuman te Balaud te Manama. 9 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre]Su ka me suhu ne miggendue, “Kene ka panlibug, kene ka himatey, kene ka panakew, kene ka keimma,” wey ka duma pad ne me suhu, nabalakes de kayi te seini ne suhu, “Geyinawei nu ka duma nu iling te peggeyinawa nu te pegkeetew nu.” 10 Su emun ke miggeyinawaan ta ka me duma ta, kene ki iya egpekeyimu te mareet diye te kandan. Purisu ka peggeyinawa te duma iyan ka katumanan te Balaud.

8 We(incl) should not be slow to pay if we(incl) have a debt to another, but let us(incl) always watch_over our(incl) debt to love_[reciprocally] every one. For the one_who_loves another fulfills the Law of God. 9 [xra][xrb][xrc][xrd][xre]For the commands that go_like_this, “Don't commit_adultery, don't kill, don't steal, don't envy,” and still other commands, (they are) just tied_together in this command, “Love(sg) your(sg) companion like your(sg) loving of your(sg) self/personhood.” 10 For if we(incl) love our(incl) companions, we(incl) are indeed not able_to_do evil to them. Therefore loving other(s) is what fulfills the Law.

11 Amana kew man-e nakanengneng ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen te seini ne timpu. Keilangan ne eggimata kew e su marani e ka kaluwasan ta du te pegbunsud ta te pegpalintutuu. 12 Egpekeiling seini te marusilem ne mahaan e egkapawe. Keilangan ne eg-engkeran tad e ka maddeet ne hinimuwan ne eleg diye te marusilem, wey egsaliyuwan tad e te meupiya ne hinimuwan ne iyan eleg ne panganiban te seeye se diye te malayag. 13 Iyan ta eg-ikulen ka meupiya ne peg-ugpe ne eleg eggimuwen te maaldew. Kene ki egpanaman-taman egsahakeen wey egpewubug-hubug, wey eg-amung-amung te me agkayen, wey kene ki eggimu te malindit ne igkeupii te lawa ta. Kene ki egmeeg-ehetey wey egkasekel te tagse sabeka. 14 Ke kene, igsaluub ta isip kumbale ka Magbebaye ne si Hisu Kristu, wey kene ta egtuhutan ne egkaparuyun-duyunan ta ka igkeupii te lawa ta ne makasesale.

11 You(pl) also know very_well what is fitting to do at this time. (It is) necessary that you(pl) wake_up because our(incl) salvation is nearer than at our(incl) beginning of faith. 12 This is like nighttime that will_ soon _dawn. (It is) necessary that we(incl) discard evil deed(s) that are fitting for the nighttime, and we(incl) exchange (them) for good deed(s) that are fitting weapons for those in the light. 13 What we(incl) will_follow/imitate is good living that is fitting to do in the daytime. We(incl) will not excessively feast and get_drunk, and be_involved in lustful_sexual_immorality, and we(incl) will_ not _do the dirty_things that our(incl) bodies desire. We(incl) will_ not _quarrel_with_one_another or be jealous of each one. 14 But rather, let us(incl) put_on as if a shirt the Lord who is Hisu Kristu, and let us(incl) not permit that we(incl) indulge the desire of our(incl) sinful bodies.

Kene ki eggukum te duma

Let us(incl) not judge another

141 [xr]Ke due etew ne mahuye se pegpalintutuu, dawata niyu sikandin te ware pegpakig-apul te kandin ne suman-suman. 2 Panunggilingan, seeye se mahuye ne migpalintutuu ne kene egkakeen ka ngalap, iyan de egkeenen se gulay. Piru ka duma migpalintutuu ne egkakeen ka minsan nekey. 3 Seeye se egkeen te minsan nekey, kene din eglemetan seeye se gulay re se egkeenen. Ne seeye degma se gulay re se egkeenen, kene din egdew-ayen ka egkeen te minsan nekey su indawat sikandin te Manama. 4 Purisu nekey naa ka katenged ta te pegdew-ey te suluhuanen te duma? Su ka ahalen din de ka due katenged ne eglalag ke mareet ka inggimu rin wey ke meupiya naa. Ne igkabennali iya ne meupiya ka eggimuwen din su egbulihan sikandin te Magbebaye.

141 [xr]If there_is a person who is weak in faith, accept(pl) him without disagreeing about his thinking. 2 For_example, those weak (ones) who believe that meat can't be eaten, (they) only eat vegetables. But another believes that it is possible to eat whatever. 3 The (one) who eats whatever, he (should) not look_down_on the one_who_eats only vegetables. And also the (one who) only eats vegetables, he (should) not criticize the one_who_eats whatever for God has accepted him. 4 Therefore what is our(incl) right to criticize a servant of another? For only his master has the right to say whether what he did is bad or good. And what he does will_ indeed _be_approved as good for he will_be_helped by the Lord.

5 Due egsuman-suman ne due mahal ne aldew ne nakasangi te duma ne aldew, piru ka duma egsuman-suman ne nenekeg-iling de ka langun ne me aldew. Ne ka tagse sabeka keilangan ne kene egduwa-ruwa te insuman-suman din. 6 Ka migsuman-suman ne due mahal ne aldew, inggimu rin sika eyew te pegtahud te Manama. Iling naan ded ka egkeen te minsan nekey, inggimu rin sika eyew te pegtahud te Manama su migpasalamat ma sikandin te ingkeen din. Ka kene egkeen te minsan nekey, inggimu rin sika eyew degma te pegtahud te Manama su migpasalamat ma sikandin te ingkeen din. 7 Su neetew ki, kene ne para te kanta ne pegkeetew, wey egpatey ki, kene ne para te kanta red ne pegkeetew. 8 Ke kene, neetew ki para te Magbebaye wey egpatey ki para te Magbebaye. Purisu, minsan manekal ki pad wey ke namatey kid, kandin ki red iya te Magbebaye. 9 Su si Kristu namatey wey neuyag eyew egkeyimu sikandin ne Magbebaye te nammatey e wey te mannekal pad. 10 [xr]Purisu mania te egdew-ayen niyu wey eglemetan ka me suled niyu te egtangke ki ma langun te Manama eyew eggukuman nikandin? 11 [xr]Su nasulat te Kasulatan ne migkahi ka Magbebaye ne Manama,

5 There_is (one who) thinks that there_is a precious day that is different from another day, but another thinks that all days are just identical. Each one needs to not be indecisive (LIT have_second_thoughts) in what he thinks. 6 The one_who_thinks that there_is a day that is precious, he does that in_order to honor God. Just like that is the one_who_eats whatever, he does that in_order to honor God for he gives_thanks for what he eats. The one_who_ doesn't _eat whatever, he does that in_order to also honor God for he gives_thanks for what he eats. 7 For we(incl) were_born, not for our(incl) selves/personhood, and we(incl) will_die, not just for our(incl) selves/personhood. 8 But rather, we(incl) were_born for the Lord and we(incl) will_die for the Lord. Therefore, whether (LIT even_if) we(incl) are still alive (LIT strong) or if dead, we(incl) are really just the Lord's. 9 For Christ died and came_alive so_that he will_become the Lord of the ones_who_died and the ones_ yet _alive. 10 [xr]Therefore why do you(pl) criticize and look_down_on your(pl) brothers when we(incl) all will_face God in_order to be judged by him? 11 [xr]For it is written in the Writings that the Lord God said,

“Egpahunlibet a ne egkatuman iya

“I swear that (it) will_ indeed _be_fulfilled

ne egpanimbuel ka langun diye te tangkaan ku

that everyone will_kneel in my presence

wey eg-ileen a ne Manama.”

and recognize that I am God.”

12 Sikan naa, tagse sabeka kanta egpanabak diye te Manama meyitenged te immangimu ta.

12 And so, each one of us(incl) will_answer to God concerning what we(incl) have done.

Egpanalliya ki ne kene egpakasale ka duma ta

Let us(incl) avoid making_ our(incl) companions _sin

13 Kene kid e egmarewdew-ayey, ke kene, egsabekeen ta ka suman-suman ta ne kene eggimu te minsan nekey ne egpakasaligkat wey egpakatintal te suled ta. 14 Tenged te pegsabeka ku te Magbebaye ne si Hisus, nakamemalehet a ne ware keenen ne kene egkakeen. Piru ingkene seini diye te etew ne egsuman-suman ne ingkene seeye. 15 Emun ke neenenduenan ka suled nu te egkeenen nu, ware kad nekeikul te geyinawa. Sikan naa, kene nu tuhuti ne egkareetan ka etew te egkeenen nu su migpatey si Kristu para kandin. 16 Kene ta egtuhutan ne ka in-isip ta ne meupiya, egmareeten te duma. 17 Su ka Peghari te Manama kene ne meyitenged te keenen wey inumen, ke kene, meyitenged te pegkamatareng, keupianan, wey kahale ne egpuun te Panisingan te Manama. 18 Su emun ke iling due ka paahi ta te pegpamakey ki Kristu, igkahale ki te Manama wey igkabennali te me etew.

13 Let us(incl) not criticize_each_other, but rather, let us(incl) unite our(incl) mind(s) not to do anything that is able_to trip or is able_to_tempt our(incl) brother(s). 14 As a result of my oneness with the Lord Hisus, I am certain that there_is_no food that can't be eaten. But it is forbidden to the one_who_thinks that it is forbidden. 15 If your(sg) brother is upset with what you(sg) eat, you(sg) have_ not _been_acting in love(LIT following love). And so, don't(sg) permit a person to be harmed by what you(sg) eat because Christ died for him. 16 Let us(incl) not permit what we(incl) consider good, be_considered_as_bad/evil by others. 17 For the Reigning of God is not about food or drink, but rather, about righteousness, peace, and joy from the Spirit of God. 18 For if our(incl) manner/way of serving Christ is like that, we(incl) are pleasing to God and approved by people.

19 Purisu egpakannekalan ta ka egpakabehey kanta te keupianan wey egpekeehet te pegpalintutuu te tagse sabeka. 20 Kene ta egdereetan ka inggimu te Manama tenged te keenen. Su diye te Manama, egkakeen iya ka langun, piru kene ne meupiya ke egpakasale ka duma ta tenged te egkeenen ta. 21 Kene ne meupiya ka pegkeen te ngalap wey ka peg-inum te binu, wey ka peggimu te minsan nekey ne iyan egpuunan ne egpakasale ka suled ta. 22 Ke nekey ka impalintutuuwan te tagse sabeka meyitenged kayi, meupiya ne daruwa ran de te Manama ka nekegtaheey. Egpanalanginan seeye se kene egkabantalan te insuman-suman din ne eleg ne eggimuwen. 23 Piru seeye se egduwa-ruwa wey nasi migkeen, eglegparan sikandin te Manama su kene ne uyun te impalintutuuwan din ka inggimu rin. Su sale ka peggimu te minsan nekey ne kene ne uyun te impalintutuuwan ta.

19 Therefore let us(incl) strive for what is able_to_give us(incl) peace and able_to_tighten the faith of each one. 20 Let us(incl) not harm what God has made/done as a result of food. For in God, (it is) indeed possible to eat everything, but (it is) not good if our(incl) companion sins as a result of what we(incl) eat. 21 Eating meat or drinking wine, or doing whatever that will_cause our(incl) brother to sin (LIT that is the source of our(incl) brother sinning) is not good. 22 Whatever each one believes concerning this, it is good if only God and he know about it (LIT good that just those two with God understand_between_each_other). That (one) who isn't anxious about what he thinks is the right thing_to_do will_be_blessed. 23 But that (one) who is indecisive and yet eats, he will_be_punished by God for what he did doesn't agree with what he believes. For doing anything that doesn't agree with what we(incl) believe is sin.

Ka peg-ugpe ne egpakahale te duma

Living that pleases others

151 Sikanta se neneehet e ka pegpalintutuu, keilangan ne kene ki egkeubil te igkabantali te me mahuye pad se pegpalintutuu. Kene ne iyan ta egsumsumanen ka egpakapahale te pegkeetew ta, 2 ke kene, keilangan ne ka tagse sabeka kanta egpakapahale te duma ta eyew egpakabulig ki wey egkeehet ka pegpalintutuu rin. 3 [xr]Su si Kristu ware migsuman-suman te egpakapahale te pegkeetew rin, su nasulat te Kasulatan, “Sikeddiey ka nababaan te lemet te me etew diye te keykew.” 4 Su ka langun ne nasulat dengan diye te Kasulatan, insulat eyew pegpanulu kanta wey eyew due egkapallateng ta pinaahi te peg-antus ta wey kabagget puun te Kasulatan. 5 Ne ka Manama ne migbehey kanta te kanekal te peg-antus wey kabagget, iyan egtuhut kaniyu ne egkasabeka ka suman-suman niyu te peg-ikul ki Kristu Hisus 6 eyew egkasabeka kew langun ka egdeyrey te Manama ne Amey te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu.

151 We(incl) whose faith is tightened, (it is) necessary that we(incl) won't get_frustrated with the anxieties of the (ones) still weak in faith. What we(incl) (should) think about is not pleasing our(incl) selves/personhood, 2 but rather, (it is) necessary that each one of us(incl) pleases our(incl) companion so_that we(incl) can help to tighten his faith. 3 [xr]For Kristu did not think to please his self, for it is written in the Writings, “I (am) the (one who) carried_on_(my)_back the people's insults of you(sg).” 4 For all that was_written formerly in the Scriptures, (it was) written in_order to teach us(incl) and so_that we(incl) will_have hope by_means of our(incl) suffering/enduring and (by means of) encouragement from the Writings. 5 And God who gives us(incl) strength for suffering and encouragement, (will be) the (one) to permit that you(pl) are_united in your(pl) thinking in following Kristu Hisus 6 so_that you(pl) will_ all _unite to praise the God and Father of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu.

Ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen para te kene ne me Hudiyu

The Good Report to the non Hudiyus

7 Purisu parawdawatey kew iling te pegdawat ni Kristu kaniyu eyew egkasaye ka Manama. 8 Su egnangenan ku sikaniyu te neyimu ne suluhuanen si Kristu te me Hudiyu[fn] eyew te pegpakita ne egkasalihan ka Manama, su intuman ni Kristu ka insaad te Manama diye te me kaap-apuan dan. 9 [xr]Ne kene ne sikan de, su eyew ka kene ne me Hudiyu egpakasaye degma te Manama tenged te hid-u rin. Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan,

7 Therefore accept_one_another(pl) like Kristu's acceptance of you(pl) so_that God will_be_praised. 8 For I tell you(pl) that Kristu became a servant to the Hudiyus[fn] in_order to show that God is trustworthy, for Kristu fulfilled what God promised to their ancestors. 9 [xr]And not only that, so_that the non Hudiyus will_ also _be_able_to_praise God because of his mercy. For according to what_is_written in the Writings,

“Egpasalamatan ku sikeykew

“I give_thanks to you(sg)

diye te taliware te kene ne me Hudiyu,

in the midst of the non Hudiyus,

wey eg-ulahingan ku ka ngaran nu.”

and I will_sing to your(sg) name.”

10 [xr]Ne duen pad man-e nasulat, “Gale-gale kew se kene ne me Hudiyu duma te keet-etawan te Manama!”

10 [xr]And there_is also written, “Rejoice you(pl) non Hudiyus along_with the people of God!”

11 [xr]Ne duen pad man-e nasulat,

11 [xr]And there_is also written,

“Sikaniyu se kene ne me Hudiyu,

“You(pl) non Hudiyus,

dayana niyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama.

praise(pl) the Lord God.

Sikaniyu se langun ne keet-etawan, dayana niyu sikandin!”

All of you(pl) people, praise(pl) him!”

12 [xr]Ne migsulat pad degma si prupita Isayas,

12 [xr]And prophet Isayas yet also wrote,

“Due kabuhalan ni Hisi ne egginguma

“There_is a descendant of Hisi who will_arrive

eyew egmandu te kene ne me Hudiyu,

in_order to rule_over the non Hudiyus,

wey sikandin ka egkapallatengan dan.”

and he will_be_the one_ they _hope_in.”

13 Ka Manama ne egkapallatengan ka egbehey kaniyu te dakel ne kahale wey keupianan pinaahi te pegsalig niyu kandin, su eyew ka pegpallateng niyu egkanasnasian egdakel pinaahi te geem te Panisingan te Manama.

13 God who is hoped_in is the (one who) will_give you(pl) great joy and peace by_means of your(pl) trusting in him, so_that your(pl) hopefulness will_grow even_more by_means of the power of the Spirit of God.

Ka pegsulat ni Pablu ne ware pegkehe

The writing of Pablu without reluctance

14 Me suled ku, ware pegduwa-ruwa ku ne subla kew ne meupiya wey napenu te langun ne katuenan, wey egkateu kew ne egmapanpanuluey te tagse sabeka. 15 Piru minsan pad iling due, ware e red migkehe te pegsulat ku eyew pegpasuman-suman kaniyu. Inggimu ku sika tenged te katenged ne imbehey keddi te Manama 16 eyew egpamakey ki Kristu Hisus te pegpanulu ku te kene ne me Hudiyu. Ka pegwali ku te Meupiya ne Panugtulen puun te Manama, egpekeiling te himu te talagpanubad su hendue te ighalad ku sikaniyu se kene ne me Hudiyu diye te Manama ne iyan egdawat kaniyu su immatulus kew te Panisingan te Manama. 17 Purisu te keddi ne pegsabeka ki Kristu Hisus, egpakapeggasal a te keddi ne pegpamakey te Manama. 18 Piru kena a egpaalag-alag eglalag te minsan nekey gawas te neyimu ni Kristu eyew te pegtipu te kene ne me Hudiyu ne egpakapalintutuu te Manama pinaahi te eglalahen wey eggimuwen ku. 19 Egkeyitabu man-e seini pinaahi te me palinneu wey me kein-inuwan wey te geem te Panisingan te Manama. Sikan naa ka puun te Hirusalim taman te Iliriku, in-empet ku te egwali ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Kristu. 20 Su iyan ku igkeupii ka egwali te Meupiya ne Panugtulen diye te me inged ne ware pad narinehi si Kristu, su eyew kena a egpakaampew te pabunsuran ne impes-ek te duma. 21 [xr]Su sumale te nasulat te Kasulatan,

14 My brothers, I have_no doubts that you(pl) are very good and full of all knowledge/skill, and you(pl) are skillful in teaching_[reciprocally] each one. 15 But even_though (it's) like that, I had no reluctance in my writing in_order to remind you(pl). I did this because of the responsibility that was_given to me by God 16 to serve Kristu Hisus in my teaching of the non Hudiyus. My preaching of the Good Report from God, (it is) like the work of a sacrificer because (it's) like I offer_ you(pl) non Hudiyus _as_a_sacrifice to God who accepts you(pl) for you(pl) are made_holy by the Spirit of God. 17 Therefore in my oneness with Kristu Hisus, I am_able_to_boast of my service to God. 18 But I don't dare to speak of anything except for what Kristu has done in_order to convince the non Hudiyus to believe/obey God by_means of what_ I _say and do. 19 This happened by_means of signs and miracles and the power of the Spirit of God. And so from Hirusalim as_far_as Iliriku, I preached everywhere the Good Report about Kristu. 20 For what_ I _want is to preach the good Story in a place where Christ has not yet been_heard_about, so_that I will_ not _add_on_top to the foundation that was driven_in by another. 21 [xr]For according to what_is_written in the Writings,

“Seeye se ware pad nahuhuri meyitenged kandin, egpakakita kandin,

“Those who have not yet been_told about him, (they) will_be_able_to_see him,

wey seeye se ware pad nakarineg meyitenged kandin, egpakasabut meyitenged kandin.”

and those who have not yet heard about him, (they) will_understand about him.”

Ka pegbebentaan ni Pablu ne egpanumbaley diye te Ruma

The travel_plans of Pablu to visit in Ruma

22 [xr]Purisu tenged te himu ku, kamasalig a natalehen ka egpanumbaley perem kaniyu. 23 Piru kuntee te neimpusan kud ka eggimuwen ku kayi ne me prubinsya, wey pile e ne leg-un ne egkeinniyat a ne eggendue te kaniyu, 24 egkeupian a ne egpakatulan due te kaniyu ka eggendiye te Ispanya. Egkeupian a ne egmaal-alukuyey ki pad amana te minsan malepet de ne timpu human a egleus diye te Ispanya pinaahi te pegbulig niyu. 25 [xr]Piru kuntee, eggendiye e pad te Hirusalim ka egdulung te igbulig te keet-etawan te Manama diye. 26 Su ingkahale te me matig-Masidunya wey matig-Akaya ka peg-amut-amut eyew igbulig te egkengaayu-ayu ne keet-etawan te Manama diye te Hirusalim. 27 [xr]Ingkahale dan ka pegbulig, wey eleg ka inggimu ran su iyan egpuunan ka me Hudiyu ne nakasawit ka kene ne me Hudiyu te ispirituwanen ne panalangin. Sikan naa, eleg de iya ne egbulihan dan te keuyahan ka me Hudiyu. 28 Ke igpakabehey kud diye te kandan ka nalimud ne igbulig kandan, egligkat ad e peendiye te Ispanya wey egtulan e pad due te kaniyu. 29 Nakanengneng a te peggenduen ku te kaniyu, dakel ka panalangin ne egkasaamulan ta langun puun ki Kristu.

22 [xr]Therefore because of my work, I have_been_hindered many_times from visiting you(pl). 23 But now that I have finished what_ I _am doing in this province, and for some years I have strongly_desired to go_there to you(pl), 24 I want to stop_over there when I go to Ispanya. I desire that we(incl) greatly enjoy_each_other's_friendship for even just a short time before I continue_on to Ispanya by_means of your(pl) help. 25 [xr]But now, I am going to Hirusalim carrying help for the people of God there. 26 For the from_Masidunya (ones) and from_Akaya (ones) rejoiced in contributing in_order to_help the poor people of God in Hirusalim. 27 [xr]They rejoiced in helping, and what they did was right because the Hudiyus (are) the source of the non Hudiyus participating in a spiritual blessing. And so, it is indeed right that they help the Hudiyus with provisions. 28 If/When I am_able_to_give them what_was_gathered to_help them, I will_depart to Ispanya and I will_stop_over there at your(pl)_place (LIT you(pl)). 29 I know that in my going_there to you(pl), we(incl) will_ all _share_together a great blessing from Kristu.

30 Me suled, tenged te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisu Kristu wey te geyinawa ne imbehey kanta te Panisingan te Manama, egbanasal a kaniyu ne bulihi a te peg-ampu diye te Manama. 31 Ampu kew ne egpangabangan a te Manama puun te ware migmalintutuu kandin diye te Hudiya, wey eyew kene egsamsamilian te keet-etawan te Manama diye te Hirusalim ka igdulung ku kandan. 32 Su eyew ke igtuhut te Manama, egkahale-gale a te pegginguma ku due te kaniyu wey egpakalene-lene ka geyinawa ku ne egpakigduma kaniyu. 33 Ka Manama te keupianan ka egduma kaniyu langun. Malehet iya.

30 Brothers, as a result of our(incl) Lord Hisu Kristu and the love given to us(incl) by the Spirit of God, I urge you(pl) to_help me in praying to God. 31 Pray(pl) that I will_be_rescued by God from the ones_ not _believing in him in Hudiya, and that the people of God in Hirusalim will_ not _refuse what_ I _am carrying to them. 32 So_that if God permits, I will_rejoice in my arrival to you(pl) and my love/breath will_be_relieved (LIT will_land) at being_together with you(pl). 33 The God of peace will_accompany you(pl) all. True indeed.

Ka pegpangemusta

The greetings

161 Due atebey ta ne egngaranan ki Pibi ne igkeupii ku ne igpeila-ila kaniyu. Sikandin ka migtanggu te migmalintutuu diye te Singkriya. 2 Dawata niyu sikandin te pegginguma rin due isip suluhuanen te Magbebaye su sika ka eleg ne eggimuwen te keet-etawan te Manama. Bulihi niyu sikandin te minsan nekey ne egkeilanganen din su masulug ka nabulihan din wey nalagkes ad en iya.

161 We(incl) have a sister named Pibi whom I would like to introduce to you(pl). She cares for the believers in Singkriya. 2 Accept(pl) her on her arrival as a servant of the Lord for that is the right thing_ for the people of God _to_do. Help(pl) her in whatever she needs for she has helped many and (that) indeed includes me.

3 [xr]Ipangemusta a te alunggun ne ensi Prisila wey si Akilu ne me duma ku te migpamakey ki Kristu Hisus. 4 Impangabangan a nikandan minsan eggimatayan dan e perem, sikan naa ka egpasalamatan ku sikandan. Ne kene ne sikeddi de ka egpasalamat su minsan degma ka langun ne punduk te kene ne me Hudiyu ne migmalintutuu. 5 Ipangemusta a degma te duma ne migmalintutuu ne migmanlibulung diye te baley ran.

3 [xr]I send_regards to the couple Prisila and Akila who (are) my companions in serving Kristu Hisus. 4 They rescued me even_though they could have_been_killed, and so I thank them. And not only I give_thanks for even also all the groups of non Hudiyu believers. 5 I also send_regards to the other believers who gather in their house.

Ipangemusta a degma ki Ipinitu ne miggeyinawaan ku ne iyan an-anayan ne migpalintutuu ki Kristu diye te prubinsya te Asya,6 wey ki Mariya ne migpakannekal migbulig kaniyu. 7 Ipangemusta a degma engki Andruniku wey Hunyas ne me karumaan ku te Hudiyu ne duma ku te naprisu. Mabantug sikandan ne me apustulis wey nekewun-a pad sikandan keddi migpalintutuu ki Kristu.

I also send_regards to Ipinitus whom I love who was the first believer in Kristu in the province of Asya,6 and to Mariya who strives to_help you(pl). 7 I also send_regards to Andrunikus and Hunyas who (are) my kinsman Hudiyus and were imprisoned with me. They are respected apostles and they believed in Kristu ahead of me.

8 Ipangemusta a man-e ki Ampliyatu ne miggeyinawaan ku tenged te Magbebaye, 9 wey ki Urbanu ne duma ta te migpamakey ki Kristu, wey ki Istakis ne miggeyinawaan ku. 10 Ipangemusta a degma ki Apilis ne napamalehetan e ne matinumanen ki Kristu, wey te pamilya enni Aristubulu 11 wey ni Hirudiyun ne karumaan ku te Hudiyu. Ne iling ded man-e te pamilya ni Narsisu ne migmalintutuu te Magbebaye.

8 I again send_regards to Ampliyatus whom I love because of the Lord, 9 and Urbanus our(incl) companion in serving Kristu, and Istakis whom I love. 10 I also send_regards to Apilis who was confirmed as faithful to Kristu, and to the family of Aristubulu 11 and to Hirudiyun my kinsman Hudiyu. And also similarly to the family of Narsisu who believe in the Lord.

12 Ipangemusta a man-e engki Tripina wey ki Tripusa ne migpamakey te Magbebaye, wey ki Pirsida ne miggeyinawaan ku ne migpakannekal migpamakey te Magbebaye. 13 [xr]Ne iling ded ki Rupu te egkabantug se pegpamakey te Magbebaye, wey te iney rin ne in-isip kud degma ne iney ku, 14 wey engki Asingkritu, ki Pligunti, ki Hirmis, ki Patrubas, ki Hirmas wey te me duma ran ne suled ta te pegpalintutuu. 15 Ipangemusta a degma engki Pilulugu, ki Hulya, ki Niriyu wey te atebey rin, ki Ulimpas wey te langun ne me duma ran ne keet-etawan te Manama.

12 I also send_regards to Tripina and Tripusa who serve the Lord, and Pirsida whom I love and who strives to serve the Lord. 13 [xr]And similarly to Rupu whose serving of the Lord is well-known, and his mother whom I consider my mother also, 14 and to Asingkritu, Pligunti, Hirmis, Patrubas, Hirmas and their companions who are our(incl) brothers in faith. 15 I also send_regards to Pilulugu, Hulya, Niriyu and his sister, Ulimpas and to all their companions who (are) the people of God.

16 Pegpangemusteey kew ka tagse sabeka te pegpapitew ne migpaheyinaweey kew.[fn] Migpangemusta degma kaniyu ka langun ne punduk ne migmalintutuu ki Kristu.

16 Greet_[reciprocally](pl) each one showing that you(pl) love_one_another.[fn] All of the groups of believers in Kristu also send_ you(pl) _regards.

Ka katammanan ne me paney-paney

The final warnings

17 Me suled, egpanpanayan ku sikaniyu ne bantey kew te me etew ne iyan egpuunan ne egkabaad-baad kew wey egpakasuwey kew te pegpanulu ne natuenan niyu dengan. Pakaddiyu kew naa kandan. 18 Su sika ne me etew ware migpamakey te Magbebaye ta ne si Kristu, ke kene, iyan dan impamakey ka lawa ran. Ne pinaahi te mekeinniyat ne peggulu wey meupiya ne egpamminehen ne guhuren dan, egkalimbungan dan ka mangnguwed pad se suman-suman. 19 Ka guhuren meyitenged te pegparuma-ruma niyu ki Kristu, nanengnengan te langun ne etew wey amana a nahale kaniyu. Piru igkeupii ku ne mangngateu kew te langun ne meupiya wey pakaddiyu kew te langun ne mareet. 20 Te kene egkaluhey egkatalu te Manama te keupianan si Meibulan wey egdi-diekan ta sikandin.

17 Brothers, I warn you(pl) that you(pl) watch_out(pl) for people who (are) the reason/source that you(pl) are dividing_up and you(pl) are separating from the teaching that you(pl) formerly learned. Stay_far(pl) from them. 18 For those people do not serve our(incl) Lord Kristu, but rather, what they serve is their bodies. And by_means of attractive persuasion and their speech which is good to listen to, they deceive ones_ yet _immature in thinking. 19 The story about your(pl) obeying Kristu, (it is) known by all people and I am very happy about you(pl). But I want you(pl) to be knowledgeable in all that is good and for you(pl) to stay_far from all that is evil. 20 In not a long_time the God of peace will_defeat Meibulan and we(incl) will_trample him.

Ka keupiya wey keyid-u te Magbebaye ta ne si Hisus, egkaangken niyu.

(May) the goodness and mercy of our(incl) Lord Hisus, be received by you(pl).

21 [xr]Migpangemusta kaniyu si Timutiyu ne migbulig keddi, wey ensi Lusyu, si Hasun, wey si Susipatru ne me karumaan ku te Hudiyu.

21 [xr]Timutiyu who helps me greets you(pl), and Lusyu, Hasun, and Susipatru my kinsmen Hudiyus.

22 (Sikeddiey si Tirsiyu ka impasulat te seini ne sulat, egpangemusta a degma kaniyu te migpalintutuu te Magbebaye.)

22 (I Tirsiyu was caused_to_write this letter, I also greet you(pl) who believe/obey the Lord.)

23 [xra][xrb]Migpangemusta degma kaniyu si Gayu, ka mahinged ne migpamaneyikan ku. Kayi te baley rin egliblibulung ka migmalintutuu. Ne migpangemusta red degma ensi Irastu ne talaggen-gen te seleppi te siyudad wey si Kuwartu ne suled ta.[fn]

23 [xra][xrb]Gayu also greets you(pl), the resident whom I am staying with (LIT whose house_ I _climbed_up_into). The believers gather here at his house. And Irastu the holder of the city's money and Kuwartu our(incl) brother also greet you(pl).[fn]

Ka pegsaye te Manama

Praising God

25 Egdayanen ka Manama ne eglig-en te pegpalintutuu niyu sumale te Meupiya ne Panugtulen meyitenged ki Hisu Kristu ne inwali ku. Neeles ka seini ne kamalehetan te amana ne naluhey ne timpu, 26 piru impanengneng e kuntee te Manama ne ware egtamanan diye te langun ne etew pinaahi te sinulat te me prupita. Ne migsuhu sikandin ne igpangguhud ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen diye te langun ne me nasud eyew egpalintutuu wey egtuman ka me etew.

25 God who strengthens your(pl) faith according to the Good Report about Hisu Kristu whom I preach is praised. This truth was hidden for a very long time, 26 but God who is without end now makes_ it _known to all people by_means of the writings of the prophets. And he commanded that the Good Report be told to all nations so_that people will_believe and obey.

27 Pinaahi ki Hisu Kristu, egsayeen ta te ware egtamanan ka Manama ne iyan de matagseb! Malehet iya.

27 By_means of Hisu Kristu, we(incl) praise God who is wise forever (LIT without end)! True indeed.
